creators.name: Max van Leeuwen
creators.role: AR artist and creative technologist; Snap Lens Studio ambassador; co-founder of Max & Liisi
creators.bio: Dutch digital artist trained in visual effects at the Netherlands Film Academy who moved into real-time augmented reality, first at the Amsterdam AR studio GoSpooky and then with Liisi Mononen as Max & Liisi. He builds playful Lens Studio and Spectacles experiments, open-source tools and commercial lenses (Olivia Rodrigo, Snapchat), and led AR discovery workshops and an XR Sunday Social talk at A+E Lab in Chatham.
creators.why: He turns everyday things around him (a rug, a painting, his living room, the sun) into playful AR prototypes and openly shares how each one is built.
creators.role_zh: AR 艺术家、创意技术专家；Snap Lens Studio 大使；Max & Liisi 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰数字艺术家，在荷兰电影学院学习视觉特效，后来转向实时增强现实：先在阿姆斯特丹 AR 工作室 GoSpooky 工作，之后与 Liisi Mononen 组成 Max & Liisi。他用 Lens Studio 和 Spectacles 做各种好玩的实验、开源工具和商业滤镜（Olivia Rodrigo、Snapchat），也曾在查塔姆的 A+E Lab 带领 AR 入门工作坊并在 XR Sunday Social 上演讲。
creators.why_zh: 他把身边的日常物件（一块地毯、一幅画、自家客厅、甚至太阳）变成好玩的 AR 原型，并且公开分享每个作品是怎么做出来的。

creators.name: Instituto Stocos (Muriel Romero, Pablo Palacio & Daniel Bisig)
creators.role: Interactive dance research group: choreographer, composer and AI/software artist
creators.bio: Spanish-Swiss collective of choreographer Muriel Romero, composer Pablo Palacio and AI researcher Daniel Bisig that builds pieces where sensors read the dancer's body and drive swarm simulations, synthesised voice, robotic lights or a self-playing piano. Bisig, now at Zurich University of the Arts and Motion Bank, co-facilitated the Choreographic Coding Labs at A+E Lab in 2022, 2025 and at the Royal Ballet and Opera in 2026.
creators.why: They make the dancer the only performer on stage who plays everything else: light beams, piano keys and simulated swarms all answer to her gestures.
creators.role_zh: 互动舞蹈研究团体：编舞、作曲与 AI/软件艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 由编舞家 Muriel Romero、作曲家 Pablo Palacio 和 AI 研究者 Daniel Bisig 组成的西班牙-瑞士团体。他们用传感器读取舞者身体，驱动群体模拟、合成人声、机器人灯光或无人弹奏的钢琴。Bisig 现任职于苏黎世艺术大学和 Motion Bank，曾在 2022、2025 年的 A+E Lab 以及 2026 年皇家芭蕾与歌剧院的 Choreographic Coding Lab 担任带领人。
creators.why_zh: 舞台上只有舞者一个表演者，却由她“演奏”一切：光束、琴键和虚拟群体都回应她的动作。
creators.based_zh: 马德里，西班牙 / 苏黎世，瑞士

creators.name: Tim Murray-Browne
creators.role: Artist and creative technologist making interactive body-sound installations
creators.bio: British artist who builds open-ended interactive installations and dance pieces where movement tracked by cameras and sensors shapes sound, light and AI imagery, from the touring Cave of Sounds to the AI self-portrait Self Absorbed. He took part in the 2022 Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab and wrote about it as 'embodied thinking'.
creators.why: He designs interactions you understand with your body rather than your mind, inviting people to explore without instructions.
creators.role_zh: 创作身体-声音互动装置的艺术家、创意技术人
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，擅长开放式互动装置和舞蹈作品：摄像头和传感器追踪人的动作，进而塑造声音、灯光和 AI 图像，代表作从巡展多年的 Cave of Sounds 到 AI 自画像 Self Absorbed。他参加了 2022 年 A+E Lab 的 Choreographic Coding Lab，并把那次经历写成关于“具身思考”的文章。
creators.why_zh: 他设计的互动靠身体而非头脑去理解，邀请人们在没有说明的情况下自由探索。

creators.name: Clémence Debaig (Unwired Dance Theatre)
creators.role: Dance artist, maker and creative technologist; founder of Unwired Dance Theatre
creators.bio: French-born, London-based dancer who worked in software before returning to dance; she builds her own wearables, haptics and motion-capture systems to let audiences influence live dancers, locally or across the internet. Her company Unwired Dance Theatre stages telematic and WebXR performances, and she was a participant at the 2022 Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab.
creators.why: She hands the audience real control over a dancer's body and costume, turning interaction design into an ethical question about care and harassment.
creators.role_zh: 舞蹈艺术家、创客与创意技术人；Unwired Dance Theatre 创办人
creators.bio_zh: 生于法国、定居伦敦的舞者，曾在软件行业工作后重返舞蹈。她自己制作可穿戴设备、触觉装置和动作捕捉系统，让观众在现场或通过网络影响舞者。她的舞团 Unwired Dance Theatre 做远程与 WebXR 演出；她也是 2022 年 A+E Lab Choreographic Coding Lab 的参与者。
creators.why_zh: 她把控制舞者身体和服装的权力真正交给观众，让交互设计变成一个关于关怀与骚扰的伦理问题。

creators.name: Freya Björg Olafson
creators.role: Intermedia artist working with performance, video, motion capture and XR
creators.bio: Icelandic-Canadian intermedia artist whose solo performances stage the body against screens, avatars and internet footage: AVATAR (2009) on online self-display, HYPER_ (2013) with UV light and 3D projection, and MÆ – Motion Aftereffect (2019) on how XR changes the body. She joined the 2nd Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab in 2025.
creators.why: For fifteen years she has performed what screens, avatars and headsets do to the human body, often before these technologies became mainstream.
creators.role_zh: 以表演、影像、动作捕捉和 XR 创作的跨媒介艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 冰岛裔加拿大跨媒介艺术家，她的独舞让身体与屏幕、化身和网络影像对峙：AVATAR（2009）探讨网上的自我展示，HYPER_（2013）用紫外光和 3D 投影，MÆ – Motion Aftereffect（2019）讨论 XR 如何改变身体。2025 年她参加了 A+E Lab 第二届 Choreographic Coding Lab。
creators.why_zh: 十五年来她一直在舞台上演绎屏幕、化身和头显对人体的影响，而且往往早于这些技术普及。

creators.name: Zhou Zhou
creators.role: Media artist and PhD researcher in human-machine improvisation
creators.bio: Chinese media artist and PhD researcher between the UAL Creative Computing Institute and London Contemporary Dance School. His dance works use motion capture, live neuroimaging and AI pipelines to let performers and audiences reshape the digital space around them; at the 2026 CCL at the Royal Ballet and Opera he built We Say, We See, a voice-to-image installation.
creators.why: He wires the dancer's body and even brain activity directly into the stage world, so the environment improvises with the performer.
creators.role_zh: 研究人机即兴的媒体艺术家、博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 中国媒体艺术家，在伦敦艺术大学创意计算学院与伦敦当代舞蹈学院攻读博士。他的舞蹈作品用动作捕捉、实时脑成像和 AI 流程，让表演者和观众重塑周围的数字空间；在 2026 年皇家芭蕾与歌剧院的 CCL 上，他做了语音生成图像的装置 We Say, We See。
creators.why_zh: 他把舞者的身体甚至脑电活动直接接入舞台世界，让环境与表演者一起即兴。

creators.name: Harshini J. Karunaratne
creators.role: Interdisciplinary artist and creative technologist
creators.bio: Artist trained in interactive media at NYU Abu Dhabi who works with projection mapping, gesture sensors, dance and live visuals for stage, media facades and installations. At the 2026 CCL at the Royal Ballet and Opera she built a transmedial Hades from fragments of the RBO archive.
creators.why: Her early prototypes show how cheap found materials, a projector and a hand sensor can already make a responsive sculpture.
creators.role_zh: 跨领域艺术家、创意技术人
creators.bio_zh: 在纽约大学阿布扎比分校学习交互媒体的艺术家，为舞台、媒体立面和装置创作投影映射、手势传感、舞蹈与实时影像作品。在 2026 年皇家芭蕾与歌剧院的 CCL 上，她用 RBO 档案碎片搭建了一个跨媒介的冥府。
creators.why_zh: 她早期的原型说明：几件废旧材料、一台投影仪加一个手势传感器，就能做出会回应人的雕塑。
creators.based_zh: 阿布扎比，阿联酋 / 伦敦，英国

creators.name: Chelly Jin
creators.role: New media and performance artist working with movement, code and biosensors
creators.bio: Korean-American artist (MFA Media Arts, UCLA) who combines expressive programming, biosensors, projection and contact improvisation in performances and installations about belonging and healing. Her piece do.we.touch was made at the 2022 Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab.
creators.why: She turns invisible body signals such as heartbeat and brainwaves into light that everyone in the room can see.
creators.role_zh: 以动作、代码和生物传感器创作的新媒体与表演艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 韩裔美国艺术家（UCLA 媒体艺术 MFA），在表演和装置中结合诗意编程、生物传感器、投影与接触即兴，探讨归属与疗愈。作品 do.we.touch 诞生于 2022 年 A+E Lab 的 Choreographic Coding Lab。
creators.why_zh: 她把心跳、脑电这些看不见的身体信号变成全场都能看见的光。

creators.name: Chelsi Alise Cocking
creators.role: New media artist, product designer and researcher
creators.bio: American new media artist and MIT Media Lab alumna whose installations use computer vision to make movement and faces visible in new ways; she has also designed products at Dropbox and Adobe. She took part in the 2022 Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab with dancers Raianna Brown and Lenataa Goka.
creators.why: Her work asks a simple question, what if we could see our own movement, and answers it with real-time light trails in open space.
creators.role_zh: 新媒体艺术家、产品设计师、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 美国新媒体艺术家，MIT 媒体实验室校友，用计算机视觉让动作和面孔以新的方式显现；她也曾在 Dropbox 和 Adobe 做产品设计。2022 年她与舞者 Raianna Brown、Lenataa Goka 一起参加了 A+E Lab 的 Choreographic Coding Lab。
creators.why_zh: 她的作品问了一个简单的问题——如果能看见自己的动作会怎样？——并用空中实时出现的光迹来回答。
creators.based_zh: 波士顿，美国 / 纽约，美国

creators.name: Irini Kalaitzidi
creators.role: Choreographer, dancer and creative coder
creators.bio: Greek choreographer and developer who builds her own motion-capture and Kinect tools to create sound instruments inside the moving body and dances between humans and stick-figure agents. She took part in the 2022 Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab with filmmaker Stathis Doganis.
creators.why: She treats the whole moving body as a musical instrument and the stick figure as a dance partner.
creators.role_zh: 编舞、舞者、创意编程者
creators.bio_zh: 希腊编舞家兼开发者，自己搭建动作捕捉和 Kinect 工具，把身体变成会发声的乐器，也让人与火柴人形象一起跳舞。2022 年她与影像创作者 Stathis Doganis 一起参加了 A+E Lab 的 Choreographic Coding Lab。
creators.why_zh: 她把整个运动中的身体当成乐器，把火柴人当成舞伴。

creators.name: Julie C. Stamm
creators.role: Dance and media artist working with sensing, feedback and neuroaesthetics
creators.bio: Germany-based dance and media artist with a background in contemporary dance and neuroaesthetics research (Goldsmiths) who designs live-camera performances, pressure sensors and participatory games that translate movement into data and back into experience. At the 2026 CCL at the Royal Ballet and Opera she made Horrorscope, a walking game based on sea-level-rise maps.
creators.why: She keeps the technology visible on stage, so the audience watches people and machines negotiate meaning in real time.
creators.role_zh: 研究感知、反馈与神经美学的舞蹈与媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 定居德国的舞蹈与媒体艺术家，有当代舞和神经美学研究（伦敦大学金史密斯学院）背景，设计实时摄像表演、压力传感器和参与式游戏，把动作转成数据，再转回体验。在 2026 年皇家芭蕾与歌剧院的 CCL 上，她做了基于海平面上升地图的行走游戏 Horrorscope。
creators.why_zh: 她让技术在舞台上保持可见，观众看着人和机器实时地协商意义。

creators.name: Naoto Hieda
creators.role: Live-coding artist and creative technologist
creators.bio: Japanese artist known for glitchy live-coded visuals in Hydra and long-running improvised sessions with dancer Jorge Guevara, where the webcam image of the dancer is fed through code in real time. He was a participant at the 2nd Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab in 2025, where he also filmed interviews with fellow participants.
creators.why: He makes the code and the camera part of the choreography, so glitches become a duet partner.
creators.role_zh: 现场编程艺术家、创意技术人
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家，以 Hydra 现场编程的故障风格影像闻名，并与舞者 Jorge Guevara 长期即兴合作：舞者的摄像头画面被实时送进代码处理。2025 年他参加了 A+E Lab 第二届 Choreographic Coding Lab，还在现场采访了其他参与者。
creators.why_zh: 他把代码和摄像头也变成编舞的一部分，故障成了舞伴。

creators.name: Samuele Albani
creators.role: Artist and researcher in interactive sound and social choreography
creators.bio: Italian artist and computational-arts researcher (Goldsmiths) who designs collaborative instruments played by the distance, touch and poses of two or more people, using wearables and camera-based pose detection. At the 2026 CCL at the Royal Ballet and Opera he replaced one of the two players of his instrument distanze with an AI agent.
creators.why: His instruments need two bodies: the music lives in the space and intimacy between people.
creators.role_zh: 研究互动声音与社交编舞的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 意大利艺术家、计算艺术研究者（伦敦大学金史密斯学院），设计由两人或多人的距离、触碰和姿态演奏的协作乐器，使用可穿戴传感器和基于摄像头的姿态识别。在 2026 年皇家芭蕾与歌剧院的 CCL 上，他把乐器 distanze 两位演奏者中的一位换成了 AI 代理。
creators.why_zh: 他的乐器需要两个身体：音乐存在于人与人之间的距离和亲密感里。

creators.name: Fabio Lattanzi Antinori
creators.role: Artist working with data sculpture, public art and AI
creators.bio: Italian-born, London-based artist who turns live data streams such as the price of search keywords into public sculptures, LED signs, karaoke machines and generative choirs. At the 2026 CCL at the Royal Ballet and Opera he trained a language model on AI platforms' Terms and Conditions and had synthetic voices sing them.
creators.why: He makes invisible data economies audible and visible in physical, often public space.
creators.role_zh: 从事数据雕塑、公共艺术与 AI 创作的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 生于意大利、定居伦敦的艺术家，把实时数据流（例如搜索关键词的广告价格）做成公共雕塑、LED 标牌、卡拉 OK 机和生成式合唱。在 2026 年皇家芭蕾与歌剧院的 CCL 上，他用 AI 平台的用户条款训练语言模型，再让合成人声把条款唱出来。
creators.why_zh: 他让看不见的数据经济在实体空间、往往是公共空间里被看见、被听见。

creators.name: Alexander Whitley Dance Company
creators.role: Choreographer and dance-technology company
creators.bio: British choreographer whose company builds stage works and installations around motion tracking, responsive light and live motion capture, working with Marshmallow Laser Feast, Memo Akten, Children of the Light and creative technologist Luca Biada. He is a Sadler's Wells New Wave Associate and spoke with AΦE at the Physical-Digital Digital Innovation Network event.
creators.why: For more than a decade he has treated sensing technology as a dance partner, so the stage lighting and projections watch, learn from and answer the dancers.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家；舞蹈科技团体
creators.bio_zh: 英国编舞家，他的舞团围绕动作追踪、响应式灯光和实时动作捕捉创作舞台作品与装置，合作者包括 Marshmallow Laser Feast、Memo Akten、Children of the Light 和创意技术专家 Luca Biada。他是 Sadler's Wells 的 New Wave 合作艺术家，曾与 AΦE 一同参加 Digital Innovation Network 的 Physical-Digital 活动。
creators.why_zh: 十多年来他把感知技术当作舞伴：舞台上的灯光和投影会“看”舞者、向舞者学习，并对舞者作出回应。

creators.name: Zelia ZZ Tan
creators.role: Choreographer, dancer and hybrid-performance artist; co-founder of TechDanceLab
creators.bio: Hong Kong choreographer and former City Contemporary Dance Company dancer who makes hybrid performances in which dancers share the stage with motion-captured avatars, projections and AR. She co-founded TechDanceLab, studied Interactive Media for Performance at CalArts and led the 'Choreographing the In-Between' hybrid dance workshop and a collaborative lab at A+E Lab in 2025.
creators.why: She choreographs the relationship between a dancer and their own avatars, turning motion-capture glitches and delays into material for the dance.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家、舞者、混合表演艺术家；TechDanceLab 联合创办人
creators.bio_zh: 香港编舞家，曾是城市当代舞蹈团舞者。她创作的混合表演让舞者与动作捕捉化身、投影和 AR 同台。她联合创办了 TechDanceLab，在 CalArts 攻读表演互动媒体，2025 年在 A+E Lab 带领了“Choreographing the In-Between”混合舞蹈工作坊和一次协作实验室。
creators.why_zh: 她编排的是舞者与自己化身之间的关系，把动作捕捉的故障和延迟也变成舞蹈的材料。

creators.name: Pell Ensemble (Rebecca Evans)
creators.role: Digital dance company led by choreographer Rebecca Evans
creators.bio: Cross-disciplinary dance company directed by choreographer Rebecca Evans that makes digital dance works for stage, streets and classrooms, from an interactive audience-data game to a walking AR trail and dance-and-code workshops with UCL and Studio Wayne McGregor. Evans spoke alongside AΦE at the Digital Bodies + Virtual Spaces symposium and the Digital Innovation Network.
creators.why: She uses dance as a way into computing, so audiences and school students program, vote and walk their way into the choreography.
creators.role_zh: 由编舞家 Rebecca Evans 领导的数字舞蹈团体
creators.bio_zh: 由编舞家 Rebecca Evans 主理的跨学科舞团，为剧场、街道和课堂创作数字舞蹈：从用观众数据驱动的互动游戏，到步行 AR 路线，再到与 UCL、Studio Wayne McGregor 合作的舞蹈编程工作坊。Evans 曾与 AΦE 一同在 Digital Bodies + Virtual Spaces 研讨会和 Digital Innovation Network 上发言。
creators.why_zh: 她把舞蹈当作进入编程的入口，让观众和中学生通过编程、投票和行走进入编舞。

creators.name: Katie Dale-Everett Dance (KDE Dance)
creators.role: Dance company working with motion capture, VR and participatory technology
creators.bio: Company led by choreographer Katie Dale-Everett that combines dance, verbatim theatre and emerging technologies such as motion capture, VR and live camera feeds, often for wellbeing and young audiences. It presented Playscape: How to Build a Galaxy at the Digital Bodies + Virtual Spaces symposium with AΦE.
creators.why: Her pieces use technology to swap presence between people, letting audiences borrow another body's view or co-create a galaxy with avatar dancers.
creators.role_zh: 运用动作捕捉、VR 与参与式技术的舞蹈团体
creators.bio_zh: 由编舞家 Katie Dale-Everett 领导的舞团，把舞蹈、纪实剧场和动作捕捉、VR、实时摄像画面等新技术结合，常面向身心健康议题和青少年观众。舞团曾与 AΦE 一同在 Digital Bodies + Virtual Spaces 研讨会上展示 Playscape: How to Build a Galaxy。
creators.why_zh: 她的作品用技术在人与人之间交换“在场”：观众可以借用另一个身体的视角，或与化身舞者一起建造一个星系。

creators.name: Birmingham Royal Ballet (Virtual Stage)
creators.role: Ballet company with an immersive-technology programme
creators.bio: One of the UK's leading ballet companies, which under Carlos Acosta launched the Virtual Stage programme to explore AR, VR, motion capture and real-time graphics with partners such as Holosphere, including city-wide AR ballet trails. Its creative digital producer Tom Rogers joined AΦE on the Physical-Digital panel at Sadler's Wells.
creators.why: A classical company that lets ballet characters step out of the theatre onto phones and lets dancers drive 35-metre real-time backdrops with their bodies.
creators.role_zh: 设有沉浸式技术项目的芭蕾舞团
creators.bio_zh: 英国一流芭蕾舞团之一。在 Carlos Acosta 领导下启动了 Virtual Stage 项目，与 Holosphere 等伙伴一起探索 AR、VR、动作捕捉和实时图形，其中包括遍布城市的 AR 芭蕾路线。舞团的创意数字制作人 Tom Rogers 曾与 AΦE 同场参加 Sadler's Wells 的 Physical-Digital 论坛。
creators.why_zh: 一家古典舞团，却让芭蕾角色走出剧院、跳进手机，也让舞者用身体驱动 35 米长的实时背景。

creators.name: Collusion
creators.role: Art and technology commissioning organisation (ART // TECH // PLAY)
creators.bio: Cambridge-based producer that commissions interactive and projection-based public artworks, often co-created with young people in King's Lynn and the East of England, and runs the ART // TECH // PLAY artist network where AΦE spoke about their VR and AR work.
creators.why: It turns whole town centres into playable spaces with projection games, AR trails and body-tracking stories made with local young people.
creators.role_zh: 艺术与科技委约机构（ART // TECH // PLAY）
creators.bio_zh: 总部在剑桥的制作机构，委约互动和投影类公共艺术，常与金斯林及英格兰东部的年轻人共创；它运营的 ART // TECH // PLAY 艺术家网络曾邀请 AΦE 分享 VR 与 AR 创作。
creators.why_zh: 它把整个城镇中心变成可以玩的空间：投影游戏、AR 路线，以及与当地年轻人一起做的身体追踪故事。

creators.name: Violeta Ayala
creators.role: Quechua filmmaker and XR / AI artist
creators.bio: Bolivian Quechua documentary filmmaker (Cocaine Prison, The Fight) who moved into VR, AR and AI with Prison X and Huk, the Jaguaress, building Indigenous-futurist characters that respond to viewers. She spoke about Las Awichas at the University of Nottingham VIP Studio event alongside AΦE.
creators.why: She replaces the fixed film with Andean characters that listen, watch and answer the viewer in the room.
creators.role_zh: 盖丘亚族电影人、XR 与 AI 艺术家
creators.based_zh: 玻利维亚 / 澳大利亚
creators.bio_zh: 玻利维亚盖丘亚族纪录片导演（Cocaine Prison、The Fight），之后转向 VR、AR 与 AI，创作了 Prison X 和 Huk, the Jaguaress 等作品，打造会回应观众的原住民未来主义角色。她曾与 AΦE 一同在诺丁汉大学 VIP Studio 活动上介绍 Las Awichas。
creators.why_zh: 她用会倾听、会观察、会回应现场观众的安第斯角色，取代放完就结束的电影。

creators.name: Keiken (Hana Omori, Isabel Ramos, Tanya Cruz)
creators.role: Collaborative art practice working with AR filters, game worlds and performance
creators.bio: Cross-dimensional collective that builds online worlds, Instagram AR face filters, game-engine environments and performances about future bodies and empathy, including the ongoing Morphogenic Angels world shown at Serpentine and at Hellerau's Blackbox Whitecube XR symposium.
creators.why: They make wearable AR filters and playable worlds that ask how technology could make us feel for other beings.
creators.role_zh: 以 AR 滤镜、游戏世界和表演为媒介的协作艺术团体
creators.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 柏林，德国
creators.bio_zh: 一个“跨维度”艺术团体，搭建网络世界、Instagram AR 人脸滤镜、游戏引擎场景和表演，思考未来的身体与共情。她们持续创作的 Morphogenic Angels 世界曾在 Serpentine 和 Hellerau 的 Blackbox Whitecube XR 研讨会上展出。
creators.why_zh: 她们用可以“戴上”的 AR 滤镜和可玩的世界追问：技术能否让我们体会其他生命的感受？

creators.name: NONOTAK (Noemi Schipfer & Takami Nakamoto)
creators.role: Audiovisual light and projection duo
creators.bio: Studio of illustrator Noemi Schipfer and architect-musician Takami Nakamoto that builds immersive light and sound architectures from projection on layered translucent screens, kinetic light and live performance. Their performance SHIRO opened the Blackbox Whitecube XR symposium at Hellerau where AΦE showed 0AR.
creators.why: With only projected lines on scrims they fold space around the viewer and put the performers inside the illusion.
creators.role_zh: 视听灯光与投影二人组
creators.bio_zh: 由插画师 Noemi Schipfer 和建筑师兼音乐人 Takami Nakamoto 组成的工作室，用多层半透明幕上的投影、动态灯光和现场表演搭建沉浸式光与声的建筑。他们的表演 SHIRO 为 Hellerau 的 Blackbox Whitecube XR 研讨会开场，AΦE 的 0AR 也在同场展出。
creators.why_zh: 只用投在纱幕上的线条，他们就能把空间在观众周围折叠起来，并让表演者置身幻象之中。

creators.name: DARKFIELD (David Rosenberg & Glen Neath)
creators.role: Immersive audio theatre company; artistic directors David Rosenberg and Glen Neath
creators.bio: DARKFIELD builds shows inside shipping containers fitted out as a séance room, an airliner cabin or a hotel, then turns the lights off completely and tells the story through 360-degree binaural sound and physical effects. During the pandemic its DARKFIELD RADIO app moved the same trick into people's own kitchens and living rooms.
creators.why: They prove that sound alone, placed precisely around your head in total darkness, can overwrite the room you are sitting in, which is the core promise of AR without any screen.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式声音剧场团体；艺术总监 David Rosenberg 与 Glen Neath
creators.bio_zh: DARKFIELD 把集装箱布置成降神会房间、客机机舱或酒店，然后彻底关灯，只靠 360 度双耳立体声和实体特效讲故事。疫情期间，他们的 DARKFIELD RADIO 应用把同样的手法搬进观众自家的厨房和客厅。
creators.why_zh: 他们证明了：在完全黑暗中，只要把声音精确地放在你头部周围，就能覆盖你所在的真实房间——这正是不需要屏幕的 AR 的核心。

creators.name: Cybersaur Arts (Josh Garner)
creators.role: Community digital-arts company; projection and visualisation artist Josh Garner
creators.bio: Cybersaur Arts runs projection-mapping, lighting and interactive visual projects with young people and communities in Medway and Kent, often for Electric Medway and The Historic Dockyard Chatham. Workshops teach TouchDesigner, Resolume, projection mapping and movement sensors, and the results end up on building facades and festival nights.
creators.why: They turn drawings made by local people into large projected creatures and heritage trails, a practical model for community-made spatial media.
creators.role_zh: 社区数字艺术团体；投影与视觉艺术家 Josh Garner
creators.bio_zh: Cybersaur Arts 在梅德韦和肯特地区与青少年及社区合作做投影映射、灯光和互动影像项目，常与 Electric Medway 和查塔姆历史船坞合作。工作坊教大家使用 TouchDesigner、Resolume、投影映射和动作传感器，成果最后投到建筑立面和节庆夜晚上。
creators.why_zh: 他们把当地居民的手绘变成巨型投影生物和历史寻访路线，是社区共创空间媒体的实用范例。

creators.name: Arcade (Arcade Ltd)
creators.role: Spatial design and AR studio ('The Spatial Agency')
creators.bio: Arcade was a digital practice founded by architects, technologists, game developers and strategists that used AR and VR to connect people to places through play. Its 2019 projects included A Vixen's Tale for Welsh National Opera, an AR guide for the SEA LIFE London Aquarium, a Madame Tussauds app that animated wax figures, and an AR literary trail for the Roald Dahl Museum.
creators.why: Its architect-led AR mixes built physical sets with phone overlays, so the real object and the digital layer are designed together.
creators.role_zh: 空间设计与 AR 工作室（自称“The Spatial Agency”）
creators.bio_zh: Arcade 由建筑师、技术人员、游戏开发者和策略顾问共同创立，用 AR 和 VR“通过游戏把人与地方连接起来”。2019 年的项目包括为威尔士国家歌剧院做的 A Vixen's Tale、伦敦 SEA LIFE 水族馆的 AR 导览、让蜡像“活过来”的杜莎夫人蜡像馆应用，以及罗尔德·达尔博物馆的 AR 文学步道。
creators.why_zh: 它由建筑师主导，实体布景与手机叠加层一起设计，真实物件和数字层互为一体。

creators.name: Elly Oldman
creators.role: Illustrator and author of The Infinite Drawing
creators.bio: French illustrator who has drawn a single endless black-and-white picture, The Infinite Drawing, a little more each day on Instagram. She turned it into a giant wall fresco and floor puzzle whose characters come alive in augmented reality, animated by the studio &Friends with AR by Artefacto, and toured it to Rennes and A+E Lab's ALT*ASH in Ashford.
creators.why: She shows how a hand-drawn line illustration can become an AR playground where the whole wall is the marker and the story.
creators.role_zh: 插画师，《无尽之画》（The Infinite Drawing）作者
creators.bio_zh: 法国插画师，每天在 Instagram 上把同一幅黑白画作续画一点，形成“无尽之画”。她把这幅画做成巨型壁画和地面拼图，画中角色通过增强现实活动起来（动画由 &Friends 制作，AR 由 Artefacto 开发），先后在雷恩和 A+E Lab 的 ALT*ASH 展出。
creators.why_zh: 她展示了手绘线稿如何变成 AR 游乐场：整面墙既是识别图，也是故事本身。

creators.name: Naho Matsuda
creators.role: Visual artist working with language, data and public space
creators.bio: German-Japanese visual artist whose site-specific works examine language, communication and everyday power structures. EVERY THING EVERY TIME, produced with FutureEverything, turns live data from a city's sensors and systems into anonymous poetry on a street-side split-flap display; it has run in Newcastle, at SXSW and in Ashford for ALT*ASH.
creators.why: She makes the invisible data layer of a city readable on the spot, without a screen or an app.
creators.role_zh: 以语言、数据与公共空间为创作对象的视觉艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 德日混血视觉艺术家，作品多为特定场域创作，探讨语言、沟通方式和日常权力结构。与 FutureEverything 合作的 EVERY THING EVERY TIME 把城市传感器和系统产生的实时数据改写成匿名诗句，显示在街边的翻牌显示屏上，曾在纽卡斯尔、SXSW 以及 ALT*ASH 的阿什福德街头展出。
creators.why_zh: 她不用屏幕和应用，就让城市看不见的数据层在现场变得可读。

creators.name: Sarah Ticho
creators.role: XR director and founder of Hatsumi; co-director of Soul Paint
creators.bio: Artist and producer working where immersive technology meets health and wellbeing. With Niki Smit she directed Soul Paint, a VR body-mapping experience in which people paint where they feel emotions on and around a virtual body; it won the SXSW 2024 XR Special Jury Prize, and she co-founded the XR Health Alliance.
creators.why: Soul Paint uses 3D drawing on a body as a language for feelings that words cannot reach.
creators.role_zh: XR 导演、Hatsumi 创始人；Soul Paint 联合导演
creators.bio_zh: 在沉浸式技术与健康福祉交叉领域工作的艺术家和制作人。她与 Niki Smit 共同执导 Soul Paint：一个 VR 身体地图体验，参与者在虚拟身体上和周围画出自己感受情绪的位置。该作品获得 2024 年 SXSW XR 评审团特别奖；她还是 XR Health Alliance 的联合创始人。
creators.why_zh: Soul Paint 把“在身体上立体绘画”变成表达情绪的语言，说出语言说不出的感受。

creators.name: Camille Dunlop
creators.role: Digital, spatial and speculative designer
creators.bio: Architecture-trained designer who has worked with the speculative design studio Superflux and teaches Cinematic and Videogame Architecture at the Bartlett (UCL) and at Central Saint Martins. As a 2025 A+E Lab artist in residence she built Anatomy of Embodied Ecologies, a live Unreal Engine landscape of the Thames Estuary mudflats that reacts to the bodies in front of it.
creators.why: She uses a game engine as a living ecosystem that audiences disturb and shape with their movement.
creators.role_zh: 数字、空间与思辨设计师
creators.bio_zh: 建筑背景的设计师，曾与思辨设计工作室 Superflux 合作，并在伦敦大学学院巴特莱特建筑学院教授“电影与游戏建筑”、在中央圣马丁任教。作为 2025 年 A+E Lab 驻地艺术家，她创作了 Anatomy of Embodied Ecologies：一个以泰晤士河口泥滩为原型、能对面前人体做出反应的 Unreal Engine 实时景观。
creators.why_zh: 她把游戏引擎当成活的生态系统，观众用身体动作去扰动和塑造它。

creators.name: HsienYu Cheng (鄭先喻)
creators.role: Artist and software developer; interactive and bio-electronic installations
creators.bio: Taiwanese artist and software developer (born 1984, Kaohsiung) whose humorous electronic installations, software and bio-electronic devices question how technology conditions human behaviour. His works include a cube that locks up and drains visitors' phones, a 7-metre drawing machine whose operator cannot see the result, and an AI follow-spot that tracks passers-by; in 2024 he led A+E Lab's Hi-Tech Garden workshops connecting children to plant biodata.
creators.why: He designs interactions around constraints and absurd rules, which makes people notice how machines already steer them.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、软件开发者；互动与生物电子装置
creators.bio_zh: 台湾艺术家兼软件开发者（1984 年生于高雄），以幽默的电子装置、软件和生物电子设备，追问科技如何规训人的行为。作品包括会锁住并耗尽观众手机电量的方盒、操作者看不到画面的 7 米长绘画装置，以及用 AI 跟随路人的追光灯；2024 年他在 A+E Lab 主持 Hi-Tech Garden 工作坊，让孩子通过植物生物数据与植物“对话”。
creators.why_zh: 他围绕限制和荒诞规则来设计互动，让人意识到机器早已在操控我们。

works.title: Age of Mythology in AR
works.description: A fan-art homage to the classic real-time strategy game: tiny villagers, temples and water from Age of Mythology appear on his living-room floor and outdoors, and he commands units with his hands through Snap Spectacles.
works.description_zh: 向经典即时战略游戏致敬的同人作品：《神话时代》里的小村民、神庙和水面出现在他家客厅地板和户外，他戴着 Snap Spectacles 用手指挥单位。
works.idea_en: Play a classic top-down strategy game as a diorama on your own floor.
works.idea_zh: 把经典俯视角策略游戏变成铺在自家地板上的微缩沙盘来玩。
works.technique: Low-poly game scenes are placed on detected ground planes in Lens Studio and recorded live on Spectacles; hand tracking selects and moves units, and the water uses looping sprite-sheet animation in a shader.
works.technique_zh: 在 Lens Studio 中把低多边形游戏场景放到识别出的地面上，并在 Spectacles 上实时录制；手部追踪用来选择和移动单位，水面用着色器里循环播放的序列帧动画实现。
works.exercise_en: Build a tabletop mini-game in AR Foundation or WebXR where the player taps to send five tiny units to collect objects around a real table. Twist: make the units avoid real obstacles such as a cup placed on the table.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 WebXR 做一个桌面小游戏：点击屏幕，派五个小单位去收集真实桌面上的物品；变体：让小单位绕开桌上真实的障碍物，比如一个杯子。

works.title: Polygon Studio
works.description: An open-source low-poly 3D modelling tool for AR glasses: you pinch and drag vertices with your fingers to build meshes in the air, walk around them, model together with friends in a shared session, and export the result as a sequence of QR codes.
works.description_zh: 一个面向 AR 眼镜的开源低多边形建模工具：用手指捏住并拖动顶点，在空中搭出网格，可以绕着作品走动，也能和朋友在共享会话里一起建模，最后把模型导出成一串二维码。
works.idea_en: Sculpt 3D models with your bare hands in the room, together with friends.
works.idea_zh: 徒手在房间里和朋友一起捏出三维模型。
works.technique: Spectacles hand tracking detects pinch gestures that grab and move mesh vertices, the mesh is rebuilt in real time with a MeshBuilder, the scene is synced via Snap's connected-lens multiplayer, and the model data is encoded into QR codes for export.
works.technique_zh: Spectacles 的手部追踪识别捏合手势来抓取和移动网格顶点，用 MeshBuilder 实时重建网格，通过 Snap 的联机 Lens 同步多人场景，并把模型数据编码成二维码导出。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR or Quest hand-tracking scene where pinching creates a point in the air and every three points form a triangle. Twist: let two people add points to the same shared shape.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 Quest 手部追踪做一个场景：捏一下就在空中生成一个点，每三个点连成一个三角面；变体：让两个人同时往同一个共享形体里加点。

works.title: Pocket Buddy
works.description: A virtual-pet game where you scan a friend to turn them into a pocket-sized pet; the pet has wishes, and you keep it happy by finding the requested real objects (over 30 are recognised) with your camera. It won Lens of the Year at Lens Fest 2024.
works.description_zh: 一款虚拟宠物游戏：扫描一个朋友，把他变成口袋大小的宠物；宠物会许愿，你要用摄像头在现实中找到它想要的物品（能识别 30 多种）来让它开心。该作品获得 Lens Fest 2024 年度 Lens 奖。
works.idea_en: Scan your friend into a pet that asks you to find real things.
works.idea_zh: 把朋友扫描成一只宠物，它会让你去现实中找东西。
works.technique: The lens captures the person's texture and name into persistent storage, maps it onto a small animated character, and uses an on-device object-detection model to check whether the item the pet wants is in view.
works.technique_zh: Lens 把人物的贴图和名字保存到持久化存储中，映射到一个会动的小角色身上，再用手机端的物体识别模型判断宠物想要的物品是否出现在画面里。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR pet with Teachable Machine or a COCO object detector that asks for one everyday object at a time and reacts happily when the camera sees it. Twist: the pet's mood slowly drops if you ignore it for a minute.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 或 COCO 物体识别模型做一个手机 AR 宠物：它每次要一个日常物品，摄像头看到后它就开心地回应；变体：如果一分钟没理它，它的心情会慢慢变差。

works.title: City Carpet AR
works.description: A children's city play-rug comes alive: tiny cars drive along the printed roads, stop at red lights and move aside for police cars, seen through Spectacles or the Snapchat app. Left running, the carpet city eventually jams into full gridlock.
works.description_zh: 一块儿童城市游戏地毯活了过来：小汽车沿着印在地毯上的道路行驶，遇红灯停车，给警车让路，可以用 Spectacles 或 Snapchat 观看。放着不管，地毯城市最后会堵成一团。
works.idea_en: Bring a printed toy map to life with autonomous traffic.
works.idea_zh: 让印刷的玩具地图长出自动驾驶的交通。
works.technique: The rug is tracked as an image marker; cars follow hand-placed waypoints along the roads and use simple rules (collision checks, traffic lights, yielding to police) with only a few cars checking at a time for performance.
works.technique_zh: 地毯作为图像标记被追踪；小车沿着手工放置在道路上的路径点行驶，使用简单规则（碰撞检测、红绿灯、给警车让路），并且每帧只让少数车辆做检测以节省性能。
works.exercise_en: Print a simple road map on A3, track it as an image target in Lens Studio or AR Foundation and make three cars loop along waypoints. Twist: add a tappable traffic light that makes all cars stop.
works.exercise_zh: 在 A3 纸上打印一张简单的道路图，用 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 作为图像目标追踪，让三辆小车沿路径点循环行驶；变体：加一个可以点击的红绿灯，让所有车停下。

works.title: PS1 Hagrid in AR
works.description: A nostalgic level built on top of his real office: low-poly Hagrid and other props from the PlayStation 1 Harry Potter games stand along a path, complete with wobbly vertices and warped textures.
works.description_zh: 在他真实办公室上搭建的一段怀旧关卡：PlayStation 1 版《哈利·波特》里的低多边形海格和各种道具沿着一条路径排开，连顶点抖动和贴图扭曲都原样再现。
works.idea_en: Overlay a retro video-game level, glitches included, on a real place.
works.idea_zh: 把一段连同瑕疵一起复刻的复古游戏关卡叠加到真实地点上。
works.technique: The office was 3D-scanned with Polycam and turned into a Custom Landmarker for alignment; custom shaders fake PS1 artefacts such as affine texture sampling and vertex snapping.
works.technique_zh: 先用 Polycam 三维扫描办公室，再做成 Custom Landmarker 来对齐场景；自定义着色器模拟 PS1 的仿射贴图采样和顶点抖动等画面瑕疵。
works.exercise_en: Scan a school corridor with Polycam, align a WebXR or Lens Studio scene to it and place three low-poly characters along the path. Twist: add a vertex-snapping shader so everything wobbles like a 1990s console.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描学校走廊，在 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 里把场景对齐上去，沿路摆放三个低多边形角色；变体：加一个顶点吸附着色器，让一切像 90 年代游戏机那样抖动。

works.title: Bold and Brash IRL
works.description: A real copy of Squidward's famous 'Bold and Brash' painting from SpongeBob is augmented with a silly AR scene that recreates the cartoon moment, made with Cyriel Verkuijlen.
works.description_zh: 一幅真实复制的《海绵宝宝》中章鱼哥名画“Bold and Brash”，被叠加上一段搞笑的 AR 场景，重现动画里的经典桥段；与 Cyriel Verkuijlen 合作完成。
works.idea_en: Let a famous cartoon painting act out its own scene.
works.idea_zh: 让一幅著名的卡通画自己演出它的那场戏。
works.technique: The physical painting is tracked as an image marker in Lens Studio, and animated 3D elements modelled in Houdini are anchored to its frame.
works.technique_zh: 在 Lens Studio 中把实体画作当作图像标记追踪，把在 Houdini 中建模的三维动画元素锚定到画框上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a poster or painting in the school, track it as an image target and animate one element leaving the frame. Twist: the element reacts differently when the viewer steps closer.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校里选一张海报或画，把它作为图像目标追踪，让画中的一个元素动起来并走出画框；变体：观众靠近时，这个元素做出不同的反应。

works.title: AR Treasure Hunt
works.description: A pirate scavenger hunt that adapts to your room: a cannon faces the nearest wall and blasts a hole in it, minigames lead you on, and a hand-drawn pirate map of your actual surroundings shows the red X, made with Liisi Mononen at GoSpooky.
works.description_zh: 一个会适应你房间的海盗寻宝游戏：大炮会对准最近的墙并在上面轰出一个洞，一系列小游戏引导你前进，最后一张按你真实环境绘制的手绘风海盗地图标出红色 X；与 Liisi Mononen 在 GoSpooky 合作完成。
works.idea_en: Turn a scan of your own room into a pirate treasure map.
works.idea_zh: 把你自己房间的扫描结果变成一张海盗藏宝图。
works.technique: Real-time world meshing (LiDAR, with a machine-learning fallback) builds a model of the room; the map is rendered from that mesh in a hand-drawn style, and debris uses baked camera textures so the 'broken wall' matches the real one.
works.technique_zh: 实时世界网格（LiDAR，无 LiDAR 时用机器学习兜底）生成房间模型；地图基于这个网格以手绘风格渲染，碎片使用烘焙的摄像头贴图，让“被打破的墙”与真实墙面一致。
works.exercise_en: Use a LiDAR phone or WebXR plane detection to find the largest wall in the room and place an AR target there; draw a top-down sketch map of the detected planes. Twist: hide the treasure behind the wall so players must walk to find it.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机或 WebXR 平面检测找出房间里最大的一面墙，在上面放一个 AR 靶子，并把检测到的平面画成俯视草图地图；变体：把宝藏藏在墙后，玩家必须走过去才能找到。

works.title: AR Portal Gun
works.description: A working portal gun on a phone: you shoot two portals onto the walls of his living room or office and look through one to see the room from the other portal's position, running in real time.
works.description_zh: 手机上的一把能用的传送门枪：在他家客厅或办公室的墙上射出两个传送门，从一个门看进去，就能看到从另一个门位置看到的房间，实时运行。
works.idea_en: Shoot portals into real walls and see your own room from somewhere else.
works.idea_zh: 在真实墙面上射出传送门，从别的位置看见自己的房间。
works.technique: The rooms were pre-scanned with Metascan and aligned with Snap's Custom Landmarker, so the lens can render the scanned 3D room from the second portal's viewpoint; LiDAR or ML depth handles the wall hits.
works.technique_zh: 房间事先用 Metascan 扫描，并用 Snap 的 Custom Landmarker 对齐，因此 Lens 能从第二个传送门的视角渲染扫描出的三维房间；墙面命中由 LiDAR 或机器学习深度完成。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room with Polycam, load the model into a WebXR or Unity scene aligned to the real room, and place a portal whose view is rendered by a second camera at another spot. Twist: let the user tap to move the exit portal.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描一个房间，把模型导入与真实房间对齐的 WebXR 或 Unity 场景，放一个传送门，门内画面由放在另一处的第二台相机渲染；变体：让用户点击来移动出口传送门。

works.title: Real-Time Body Clones
works.description: A Snapchat lens that freezes 3D copies of your body as you move; tap to leave a single clone or hold to paint a trail of textured bodies through the room.
works.description_zh: 一个 Snapchat 滤镜，会在你移动时把你的身体冻结成一个个三维复制品；点一下留下一个分身，按住就会在房间里拖出一串带贴图的身体轨迹。
works.idea_en: Leave frozen 3D copies of yourself behind as you move.
works.idea_zh: 边走边留下自己凝固的三维分身。
works.technique: The MeshBuilder API copies the current tracked 3D body mesh into a static mesh, then the camera texture from that moment is projected back onto it so the clone keeps your real clothes and colours.
works.technique_zh: 用 MeshBuilder API 把当前追踪到的三维人体网格复制成静态网格，再把那一刻的摄像头画面投射回网格上，让分身保留你真实的衣服和颜色。
works.exercise_en: Use a body-segmentation lens or MediaPipe selfie segmentation to snapshot the cut-out person every second and leave the snapshots floating in the scene. Twist: make older clones slowly fade and drift upward.
works.exercise_zh: 用人体分割滤镜或 MediaPipe 人像分割，每秒截取一次抠出的人像，让这些截图留在场景中；变体：让越早的分身越透明并慢慢向上飘走。

works.title: Nuclei AR
works.description: Thousands of glowing particles cling to a person's body in 3D and copy their colours, while the real person underneath is painted out, so they seem to dissolve into a cloud of 'nuclei'. It was shown at the Max Ernst Museum and on Snap's AR mirrors.
works.description_zh: 成千上万个发光粒子在三维空间中附着在人的身体上并复制其颜色，而下方真实的人被抹除，看起来就像溶解成了一团“细胞核”。作品曾在马克斯·恩斯特博物馆和 Snap 办公室的 AR 魔镜上展示。
works.idea_en: Replace a person with a particle cloud that keeps their colours.
works.idea_zh: 用一团保留原本颜色的粒子云替换掉一个人。
works.technique: 3D body tracking drives particle emitters on the body mesh, particles sample the camera colour at their position, and person inpainting removes the real body before the particles are composited on top.
works.technique_zh: 三维人体追踪驱动附着在人体网格上的粒子发射器，粒子在所在位置采样摄像头颜色，同时用人像修补把真实身体抹掉，再把粒子合成上去。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe pose or a Lens Studio body template to emit particles from each joint, coloured by the camera pixel beneath them, over a blurred background. Twist: particles scatter when the person moves fast and regroup when they stand still.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 姿态或 Lens Studio 人体模板，从每个关节发射粒子，粒子颜色取自其下方的摄像头像素，背景做模糊处理；变体：人快速移动时粒子四散，静止时再重新聚拢。

works.title: Holiday Lights AR
works.description: Tap and drag to hang strings of festive lights on the walls and furniture of any room; the lights stick to the real surfaces. Made at GoSpooky and updated to use Snap's world meshing on ARKit and ARCore.
works.description_zh: 点按并拖动，就能在任何房间的墙壁和家具上挂起一串串节日彩灯，彩灯会贴合在真实表面上。作品在 GoSpooky 制作，后来升级为使用 Snap 在 ARKit 和 ARCore 上的世界网格功能。
works.idea_en: Decorate any room with light strings by drawing on its walls.
works.idea_zh: 在墙上画一笔，就能用彩灯装饰任何房间。
works.technique: Screen touches are raycast against a real-time world mesh (LiDAR or an ML fallback), and a string of emissive bulbs is spawned along the hit points so it follows the real geometry.
works.technique_zh: 屏幕触点对实时世界网格（LiDAR 或机器学习兜底）做射线检测，沿命中点生成一串自发光灯泡，使其顺着真实几何表面排布。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR hit-test app that places a glowing bulb wherever the finger drags across a detected surface, connected by a wire. Twist: make the bulbs blink in sequence to music from the phone microphone.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 命中测试应用：手指在检测到的表面上拖动时，沿路放下发光灯泡并用电线连起来；变体：让灯泡随手机麦克风听到的音乐依次闪烁。

works.title: Butterflies AR
works.description: A flock of butterflies flutters around the room, lands on real surfaces such as plants and railings, avoids bumping into them and follows a moving point in space; he released it as a free Lens Studio asset.
works.description_zh: 一群蝴蝶在房间里飞舞，会落在植物、栏杆等真实物体表面，避开碰撞，并跟随空间中一个移动的点；他把它作为免费的 Lens Studio 素材发布。
works.idea_en: Let virtual butterflies land on the real objects around you.
works.idea_zh: 让虚拟蝴蝶停落在你身边的真实物体上。
works.technique: Each butterfly steers with simple flocking rules and raycasts against the LiDAR world mesh to find landing spots and avoid collisions; count, flight radius and flying 'character' are adjustable at runtime.
works.technique_zh: 每只蝴蝶按简单的群体规则飞行，并对 LiDAR 世界网格做射线检测来寻找落点、避免碰撞；数量、飞行半径和飞行“性格”都能在运行时调整。
works.exercise_en: Make five AR butterflies in WebXR or AR Foundation that fly randomly and land on the nearest detected plane after a few seconds. Twist: they fly away when the phone moves too close.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或 AR Foundation 里做五只 AR 蝴蝶，随机飞行几秒后落到最近检测到的平面上；变体：手机靠得太近时它们会飞走。

works.title: Exploding Stuff in AR
works.description: Objects in the room appear to blow up: smoke and debris burst out and bounce off the real floor and furniture, and they pick up the colours and textures of the surroundings, created for a project with BLNK Digital.
works.description_zh: 房间里的物体仿佛被炸开：烟雾和碎片喷射而出，在真实的地板和家具上弹跳，并带上周围环境的颜色和纹理；为与 BLNK Digital 合作的项目制作。
works.idea_en: Make real surroundings look destructible.
works.idea_zh: 让真实环境看起来可以被摧毁。
works.technique: A real-time LiDAR world mesh acts as a physics collider for debris, and the debris and smoke sample the camera image so they match the environment.
works.technique_zh: 实时 LiDAR 世界网格作为碎片的物理碰撞体，碎片和烟雾采样摄像头画面，使其与环境相匹配。
works.exercise_en: In AR Foundation with meshing or Reality Composer, spawn 30 physics cubes that fall and bounce on the real floor and table when you tap. Twist: colour each cube with the camera pixel where it was spawned.
works.exercise_zh: 用带网格功能的 AR Foundation 或 Reality Composer，点击屏幕时生成 30 个物理方块，在真实地板和桌面上掉落弹跳；变体：每个方块的颜色取自其生成位置的摄像头像素。

works.title: Hijacking Magritte's Treachery of Images
works.description: At LACMA he 'hijacked' René Magritte's famous painting of a pipe ('This is not a pipe'), using AR to continue the painting's story on the museum wall.
works.description_zh: 他在洛杉矶郡艺术博物馆（LACMA）用 AR“劫持”了马格利特那幅著名的烟斗画（《这不是一只烟斗》），在博物馆墙上接着讲下去这幅画的故事。
works.idea_en: Continue a famous artwork's narrative in AR, right in the museum.
works.idea_zh: 直接在博物馆里用 AR 为一件名作续写故事。
works.technique: The painting is likely tracked as an image marker in Lens Studio, with animated 3D content anchored to the canvas so the added story plays out in front of the original.
works.technique_zh: 画作很可能在 Lens Studio 中作为图像标记被追踪，把三维动画内容锚定在画布上，让续写的故事在原作前上演。
works.exercise_en: Choose a reproduction of a well-known painting, track it as an image target, and add one AR animation that answers the painting's question or joke. Twist: make the AR continuation disagree with the original.
works.exercise_zh: 选一幅名画的复制品作为图像目标，加一段回应画作问题或笑点的 AR 动画；变体：让 AR 续写与原作唱反调。

works.title: Any Object as a Push Button
works.description: A work-in-progress setup for Spectacles that turns any physical object into a push button: pressing the real object with your finger triggers a virtual response, giving AR interaction a physical feel.
works.description_zh: 为 Spectacles 做的一个进行中的原型：把任何实体物件变成按钮，用手指按下真实物体就会触发虚拟反馈，让 AR 交互有了实在的手感。
works.idea_en: Any real object can become a button you press with your finger.
works.idea_zh: 任何真实物体都可以变成用手指按下的按钮。
works.technique: Likely a virtual button collider is placed on the chosen object, and Spectacles fingertip tracking detects when the finger moves into it, triggering animation and sound.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是在选中的物体上放一个虚拟按钮碰撞体，由 Spectacles 的指尖追踪检测手指是否按入，再触发动画和声音。
works.exercise_en: Place an invisible button collider on a real mug using WebXR hand tracking or a Quest, and play a sound when the fingertip touches it. Twist: each object in the room plays a different note, making an instrument out of the desk.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 手部追踪或 Quest，在一个真实杯子上放一个隐形按钮碰撞体，指尖碰到时播放声音；变体：房间里每个物体发出不同的音，把书桌变成一件乐器。

works.title: Fourier Series in AR
works.description: Inspired by 3Blue1Brown, you draw a shape in the air with your hand on Spectacles and a chain of spinning circles (epicycles) redraws it; opening your hand stabilises the drawing.
works.description_zh: 受 3Blue1Brown 启发：戴着 Spectacles 用手在空中画一个形状，一串旋转的圆（本轮）会把它重新画出来；张开手掌可以让图形稳定下来。
works.idea_en: Watch spinning circles redraw the shape you just drew in the air.
works.idea_zh: 看一串旋转的圆把你刚在空中画的形状重新画出来。
works.technique: The hand-drawn path is sampled, a discrete Fourier transform turns it into rotating vectors, and these are rendered as nested circles in 3D whose tip traces the shape.
works.technique_zh: 对手绘路径采样，用离散傅里叶变换把它变成一组旋转向量，再在三维中渲染成层层嵌套的圆，末端描出原来的形状。
works.exercise_en: Record a finger or mouse drawing as 100 points, compute its DFT in JavaScript and animate the epicycles in a WebXR scene. Twist: let students limit the number of circles to see the drawing simplify.
works.exercise_zh: 把手指或鼠标画的线记录成 100 个点，用 JavaScript 计算离散傅里叶变换，并在 WebXR 场景中播放本轮动画；变体：让学生限制圆的数量，观察图形如何被简化。

works.title: AR Sundial
works.description: A virtual antique sundial placed outdoors that actually tells the time: it is rotated for your latitude and lit by the sun's real position, so its AR shadow reads the true solar time.
works.description_zh: 一个放在户外的虚拟古董日晷，而且真的能看时间：它按你所在的纬度旋转，并由太阳的真实位置照亮，所以它的 AR 影子读出的就是真实太阳时。
works.idea_en: A virtual object whose shadow is cast by the real sun and tells the time.
works.idea_zh: 一个由真实太阳投下影子、还能报时的虚拟物体。
works.technique: GPS location and time of day compute the sun's azimuth and elevation, which drive the directional light of his self-shadowing renderer (LUX) so virtual shadows align with real ones.
works.technique_zh: 用 GPS 位置和当前时间计算太阳的方位角和高度角，驱动他自研的自阴影渲染器（LUX）中的平行光，让虚拟影子与真实影子方向一致。
works.exercise_en: Use a sun-position library (e.g. SunCalc) in a WebXR app to aim a directional light and cast a virtual pole's shadow on the ground outdoors. Twist: compare it with a real stick's shadow at three times of day.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 应用中用太阳位置库（如 SunCalc）设置平行光方向，让一根虚拟杆子在户外地面上投下影子；变体：在一天中的三个时间点把它和真实木棍的影子对比。

works.title: Specs Racer
works.description: An arcade racing game for Snap Spectacles played in a physical installation with real steering wheels, pedals and start lights; Snap built the rig and he developed the game with Ninsky.
works.description_zh: 为 Snap Spectacles 打造的街机赛车游戏，玩家坐进带有真实方向盘、踏板和起跑灯的实体装置中比赛；装置由 Snap 搭建，游戏由他与 Ninsky 共同开发。
works.idea_en: Race in AR glasses using real steering wheels and pedals.
works.idea_zh: 戴着 AR 眼镜，用真实的方向盘和踏板赛车。
works.technique: Physical controllers are likely connected to the Spectacles lens over a network bridge, and a race track with physics cars is rendered in the glasses on top of the real room.
works.technique_zh: 实体控制器很可能通过网络桥接连到 Spectacles 的 Lens 上，眼镜里在真实房间之上渲染出带物理车辆的赛道。
works.exercise_en: Connect a cheap USB gamepad or a phone's gyroscope to a WebXR scene and drive a toy car around a track drawn on the real floor. Twist: two players with two phones race on the same floor track.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个便宜的 USB 手柄或手机陀螺仪连接到 WebXR 场景，驾驶一辆玩具车绕着画在真实地板上的赛道跑；变体：两名玩家用两部手机在同一条地板赛道上比赛。

works.title: AR Flower Drawing
works.description: A Spectacles lens in which a trail of flowers grows along the path you draw in the world; the length of your flower line is submitted to a global leaderboard (his record is about 20 metres).
works.description_zh: 一个 Spectacles 滤镜：你在空间中画出的路径上会长出一串花；花带的长度会提交到全球排行榜（他的纪录约为 20 米）。
works.idea_en: Draw a line of flowers through the world and compete on its length.
works.idea_zh: 在世界里画出一条花带，比比谁画得更长。
works.technique: Likely a hand-tracked drawing path is converted into a trail mesh populated with instanced flowers, with its total length measured in world units and sent to an online leaderboard.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是把手部追踪的绘制路径转成带状网格，并在上面实例化生成花朵，再用世界单位计算总长度并上传到在线排行榜。
works.exercise_en: Build a WebXR drawing app that spawns a flower every 20 cm along the finger's path and shows the total length in metres. Twist: the flowers wilt if the line crosses itself.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 WebXR 绘画应用：沿着手指路径每 20 厘米生成一朵花，并显示总长度（米）；变体：如果线条自我交叉，花就会枯萎。

works.title: Neon Face Paint
works.description: A Snapchat lens made with Liisi Mononen for Snap's Call for Creation in which you paint glowing neon strokes onto your own face; it was nominated in the Art & Expression category at Lens Fest.
works.description_zh: 与 Liisi Mononen 为 Snap “Call for Creation” 合作的 Snapchat 滤镜，可以在自己脸上画出发光的霓虹笔触；该作品入围 Lens Fest “艺术与表达”类别。
works.idea_en: Paint glowing neon lines directly onto your own face.
works.idea_zh: 直接在自己脸上画发光的霓虹线条。
works.technique: Touch strokes are likely projected onto the tracked face mesh and stored in its UV space, so the paint sticks to the skin as the face moves, with a bloom glow pass on top.
works.technique_zh: 触摸笔触很可能被投射到追踪的人脸网格上并存进其 UV 空间，因此脸部移动时颜料仍贴在皮肤上，最后再叠加一层泛光效果。
works.exercise_en: Use a face-mesh filter tool (Lens Studio, Effect House or MediaPipe Face Mesh) to let users draw on a face texture with a finger. Twist: the paint slowly drips down over time.
works.exercise_zh: 用人脸网格滤镜工具（Lens Studio、Effect House 或 MediaPipe Face Mesh）让用户用手指在人脸贴图上作画；变体：颜料会随时间慢慢往下流淌。

works.title: Dancing Self-Scan on Your Hand
works.description: His portfolio website, opened in the Spectacles browser, loads a small dancing 3D scan of himself that stands on the visitor's hand through WebXR.
works.description_zh: 他的作品集网站在 Spectacles 浏览器中打开时，会通过 WebXR 加载一个跳舞的迷你版三维扫描的他，站在访客的手上。
works.idea_en: A personal website that puts a tiny dancing you on the visitor's hand.
works.idea_zh: 个人网站会把一个跳舞的迷你版你放到访客手上。
works.technique: A rigged, animated 3D scan is loaded in a three.js WebXR session and parented to the tracked hand joints exposed by the WebXR Hand Input API.
works.technique_zh: 在 three.js 的 WebXR 会话中加载一个带骨骼动画的三维扫描模型，并把它挂到 WebXR Hand Input API 提供的手部关节上。
works.exercise_en: Scan yourself with Polycam, rig it with Mixamo and show it dancing on a hand in a three.js WebXR page on Quest or Spectacles. Twist: the figure jumps to the other hand when you clap.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 扫描自己，用 Mixamo 绑定骨骼，在 Quest 或 Spectacles 上的 three.js WebXR 网页里让它在手上跳舞；变体：拍手时小人会跳到另一只手上。

works.title: Stocos
works.description: Two dancers move inside a floor projection of an artificial swarm; the simulated agents, the music and the light react to their movement and in turn push the dancers into new patterns.
works.description_zh: 两位舞者在地面投影的人工群体中舞动；虚拟个体、音乐和灯光随她们的动作变化，又反过来推动舞者形成新的队形。
works.idea_en: Let dancers and a simulated swarm choreograph each other on the same floor.
works.idea_zh: 让舞者和一群虚拟生物在同一块地板上互相编舞。
works.technique: Body tracking feeds the dancers' positions into a swarm simulation whose agents are projected from above, and the same agent data drives stochastic sound synthesis and lighting.
works.technique_zh: 身体追踪把舞者的位置输入群体模拟，模拟出的个体从上方投影到地面，同一组数据还驱动随机声音合成和灯光。
works.exercise_en: Project a p5.js boids flock onto the floor with a cheap projector and use a webcam blob tracker so the flock avoids or follows a person walking through it. Twist: give each person a different 'smell' so the flock prefers one of them.
works.exercise_zh: 用便宜投影仪把 p5.js 的鸟群（boids）投到地面，再用摄像头追踪人的位置，让鸟群躲避或跟随走过的人；变体：给每个人不同的“气味”，让鸟群偏爱其中一人。

works.title: Embodied Machine
works.description: A dancer steers a forest of robotic light beams with her body: as she reaches and turns, the motorised lights swing to follow and illuminate her, while her movement also becomes synthetic vocal sound.
works.description_zh: 舞者用身体操控一片机器人光束“森林”：她伸展、转身，电动灯就随之摆动、照亮她，她的动作同时变成合成的人声。
works.idea_en: Turn stage lights into limbs that extend the dancer's gestures.
works.idea_zh: 把舞台灯变成延伸舞者动作的肢体。
works.technique: Wearable motion sensors are analysed for movement qualities and mapped to pan, tilt and intensity of DMX moving-head lights and to a voice synthesiser (likely custom Max or C++ software).
works.technique_zh: 可穿戴动作传感器的数据被分析出动作质感，再映射到 DMX 摇头灯的水平、俯仰和亮度，以及人声合成器（可能是自研的 Max 或 C++ 软件）。
works.exercise_en: Map a phone's orientation (via a WebSocket page) to the direction of a small servo-mounted torch so a performer 'points' light around a dark room. Twist: add a delay so the light follows like a lazy shadow.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页 + WebSocket 读取手机朝向，控制装在舵机上的小手电，让表演者在黑暗房间里“指挥”光线；变体：加入延迟，让光像懒洋洋的影子一样跟随。

works.title: Piano&Dancer
works.description: On stage are a dancer and a piano but no pianist: as the dancer moves, the piano keys press themselves and the music answers her gestures without her ever touching the instrument.
works.description_zh: 舞台上只有一位舞者和一架钢琴，没有钢琴家：舞者一动，琴键就自己按下，音乐回应她的动作，而她从未碰到钢琴。
works.idea_en: A dancer plays a piano from across the room with her body alone.
works.idea_zh: 舞者隔着空间，只用身体弹钢琴。
works.technique: Sensors on the dancer are analysed for gesture features that an algorithm translates into MIDI notes for a self-playing mechanical piano.
works.technique_zh: 舞者身上的传感器被分析出动作特征，算法再把它们转换成 MIDI 音符，驱动自动演奏的机械钢琴。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam pose model (ml5.js / MediaPipe) to turn wrist height and speed into MIDI notes played on a laptop piano sound. Twist: only let slow movements make sound.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头姿态模型（ml5.js / MediaPipe）把手腕高度和速度转成 MIDI 音符，在电脑钢琴音色上演奏；变体：只有缓慢的动作才能发声。

works.title: Cave of Sounds
works.description: Eight new electronic instruments stand in a circle around a glowing hub; visitors play them freely by moving hands through light, casting shadows or gesturing, and together improvise a shared piece of music.
works.description_zh: 八件新造的电子乐器围成一圈，中间是发光的中心；观众可以自由演奏，通过在光中移动双手、投下影子或做手势，一起即兴合奏。
works.idea_en: A circle of strange instruments turns strangers into a band without instructions.
works.idea_zh: 一圈奇特的乐器，不用说明就能把陌生人变成乐队。
works.technique: Each instrument was built by a different Music Hackspace member from sensors such as cameras, light sensors and Kinect, all synced to a shared tempo so any gesture fits the ensemble.
works.technique_zh: 每件乐器由 Music Hackspace 的不同成员制作，使用摄像头、光传感器和 Kinect 等，全部同步到同一节拍，因此任何手势都能融入合奏。
works.exercise_en: Build four 'instruments' from phone sensors in web pages (tilt, shake, microphone, camera brightness) that all quantise to one shared beat, and let visitors jam. Twist: make an instrument that only sounds when two people stand close.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页读取手机传感器（倾斜、摇晃、麦克风、摄像头亮度）做四件“乐器”，都对齐到同一节拍，让观众即兴合奏；变体：做一件只有两人靠近时才发声的乐器。

works.title: This Floating World
works.description: A dancer performs a solo inside projected vines and flowing forms that are shaped by her movement, while the score shifts with her body; later shown as an installation that visitors could dance in.
works.description_zh: 舞者在投影出的藤蔓和流动形态中独舞，这些形态随她的动作生长变化，配乐也随身体改变；后来也作为观众可以进入起舞的装置展出。
works.idea_en: The dancer grows the landscape she dances in, like a vine shaped by a wall.
works.idea_zh: 舞者“长出”她所在的风景，就像藤蔓被墙塑形。
works.technique: A 3D depth camera tracks the dancer; custom software analyses the movement and, with live input from an operator's laptop, generates the projected visuals and modulates the music.
works.technique_zh: 3D 深度摄像头追踪舞者，自研软件分析动作，并结合操作者笔记本的实时输入生成投影画面、调制音乐。
works.exercise_en: With a webcam and TouchDesigner or p5.js, project lines that grow from the performer's silhouette edges and slowly fade. Twist: let lines grow only where the dancer has stood still for three seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头加 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js，从表演者轮廓边缘投影出不断生长、慢慢消退的线条；变体：只在舞者静止超过三秒的地方长出线条。

works.title: Self Absorbed
works.description: The artist moves in front of a large screen and floats through an AI-generated stream of images and sounds made from twenty years of his own photos and recordings, steering it only with his body.
works.description_zh: 艺术家在大屏幕前移动，只用身体在一条 AI 生成的影像和声音之流中漂游，素材来自他二十年来的照片和录音。
works.idea_en: Navigate an AI's memory of your life with your body, not a mouse.
works.idea_zh: 用身体而不是鼠标，在 AI 对你人生的“记忆”里航行。
works.technique: An unsupervised model trained on how the artist moves encodes live body tracking into a low-dimensional vector that steers the latent space of image (StyleGAN) and sound models trained on his personal archive.
works.technique_zh: 一个用艺术家自身动作训练的无监督模型，把实时身体追踪编码成低维向量，再用它驾驭以其个人档案训练的图像（StyleGAN）和声音模型的潜空间。
works.exercise_en: Map three body features from a webcam pose model (arm spread, height, lean) to sliders that blend between a small set of your own photos in a web page. Twist: swap the photo set for a classmate's and see if movement still feels personal.
works.exercise_zh: 从摄像头姿态模型提取三个身体特征（手臂张开、高度、倾斜），映射成网页滑块，在你自己的几张照片之间混合；变体：换成同学的照片，看动作是否仍然“属于你”。

works.title: Where things start from
works.description: A sketch of an interactive sound space where holding a slow, sustained movement generates noise textures, tested with Kinect recordings of a dancer.
works.description_zh: 一个互动声音空间的草图：保持缓慢持续的动作会产生噪声纹理，用舞者的 Kinect 录像进行测试。
works.idea_en: Reward stillness and slowness with sound instead of fast gestures.
works.idea_zh: 用声音奖励静止和缓慢，而不是快速的手势。
works.technique: Kinect skeleton data is analysed for sustained low-velocity motion, which is mapped to the amplitude and filtering of a noise synthesiser.
works.technique_zh: 分析 Kinect 骨架数据中持续的低速运动，映射到噪声合成器的音量和滤波。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page where MediaPipe body tracking plays a drone that gets louder the slower you move. Twist: fast moves erase the sound for five seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页：MediaPipe 身体追踪控制一个持续音，动作越慢声音越大；变体：快速动作会让声音消失五秒。

works.title: Post-Truth and Beauty
works.description: A visitor steps into a ring of speakers; as they move their head, light patterns and spatial sound change so that each viewpoint reveals only a partial glimpse of an abstract world.
works.description_zh: 观众走进一圈扬声器中，移动头部时灯光图案和空间声音随之改变，每个视角只能看到一个抽象世界的片段。
works.idea_en: Truth as something you only ever see partially, depending on where your head is.
works.idea_zh: 真相只能被部分看见，取决于你的头在哪里。
works.technique: The position of the visitor's head is tracked (likely with a depth camera) and mapped to light states and to the panning of sound across a circular speaker array.
works.technique_zh: 追踪观众头部位置（可能使用深度摄像头），映射到灯光状态以及环形扬声器阵列中的声像移动。
works.exercise_en: Use a laptop face tracker to change a projected abstract image and a stereo pan as the viewer leans left, right or closer. Twist: hide one 'secret' image that appears only from one exact spot.
works.exercise_zh: 用笔记本的人脸追踪，让观众向左、向右或靠近时改变投影的抽象图像和左右声道；变体：藏一张只有在某个精确位置才出现的“秘密”图像。

works.title: BOTHER
works.description: In a durational dance installation, audience members use a web interface to trigger actions on devices worn by the dancer, influencing her well-being positively or negatively and watching the effect in front of them.
works.description_zh: 在一场长时间的舞蹈装置中，观众通过网页界面触发舞者身上设备的动作，正面或负面地影响她的状态，并当场看到结果。
works.idea_en: Give strangers a remote control over a dancer and watch how they choose to use it.
works.idea_zh: 把一个舞者的“遥控器”交给陌生人，看他们如何使用。
works.technique: A web page sends audience commands over the network to microcontroller-driven wearables (likely vibration, light or moving elements) on the dancer's body.
works.technique_zh: 网页把观众的指令通过网络发送给舞者身上由微控制器驱动的可穿戴设备（可能是振动、灯光或可动部件）。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page with two buttons, 'care' and 'bother', that trigger a vibration motor or LED on a classmate's wrist via an ESP32 while they improvise. Twist: show the audience how many people pressed each button.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个只有“关心”和“打扰”两个按钮的网页，通过 ESP32 触发同学手腕上的振动马达或 LED，同时让他即兴表演；变体：向观众显示每个按钮被按了多少次。

works.title: STRINGS
works.description: During lockdown a dancer performs live from her living room wearing electronic devices that react to the collective actions of an online audience, so remote viewers can literally hold and move her.
works.description_zh: 封城期间，舞者在自家客厅直播演出，身上的电子设备对线上观众的集体操作作出反应，远方的观众仿佛真的能“牵动”她。
works.idea_en: Dance together at a distance by letting an online crowd pull the dancer's strings.
works.idea_zh: 让线上观众拉动舞者的“线”，隔空一起跳舞。
works.technique: Audience input from a web interface is aggregated on a server and sent to networked haptic wearables on the dancer, who improvises in response on the live stream.
works.technique_zh: 网页界面收集观众输入，在服务器上汇总后发送到舞者身上的联网触觉可穿戴设备，舞者在直播中即兴回应。
works.exercise_en: Stream a performer on a video call while viewers vote with emoji on a shared web page; the majority vote vibrates a phone taped to the performer's arm or leg. Twist: require at least three people to agree before anything happens.
works.exercise_zh: 在视频通话里直播表演者，观众在共享网页上用表情投票，多数票会让绑在表演者手臂或腿上的手机振动；变体：至少三人同意才会触发。

works.title: Automata
works.description: A wearable kinetic costume whose parts move when the dancer moves, raising the question of who is controlling whom: the dancer the objects, or the objects the dancer.
works.description_zh: 一件可穿戴的动态服装，舞者一动，服装的部件也随之运动，引出一个问题：是舞者在操控物件，还是物件在操控舞者？
works.idea_en: A costume that dances back, blurring puppeteer and puppet.
works.idea_zh: 会“回舞”的服装，模糊了操偶师与木偶的界限。
works.technique: Accelerometers on the dancer's arms are read by a microcontroller that drives servo motors moving elements of the outfit.
works.technique_zh: 舞者手臂上的加速度计由微控制器读取，驱动舵机带动服装上的部件。
works.exercise_en: Attach a micro:bit to a wrist and make its tilt move a servo that flaps a paper wing on the shoulder. Twist: invert the mapping so the wing moves most when the arm is still.
works.exercise_zh: 把 micro:bit 绑在手腕上，用它的倾斜控制舵机，让肩上的纸翅膀扇动；变体：反转映射，手臂静止时翅膀动得最厉害。

works.title: Where We Meet
works.description: In an audio-based dance installation about mental health, visitors wander among solo dancers wearing headphones; walking close to a dancer triggers that dancer's inner monologue.
works.description_zh: 在一件关于心理健康的音频舞蹈装置中，观众戴着耳机在几位独舞者之间走动；靠近某位舞者时，就会听到那位舞者的内心独白。
works.idea_en: Walk close to someone and you hear what they are thinking.
works.idea_zh: 走近一个人，就能听见他在想什么。
works.technique: An indoor location-tracking system follows each visitor's position and triggers audio monologues on their headphones when they enter a zone around a performer.
works.technique_zh: 室内定位系统追踪每位观众的位置，当他们进入某位表演者周围的区域时，在耳机中触发独白音频。
works.exercise_en: Use Bluetooth beacons or printed markers plus a phone web app to play a different recorded 'thought' when a listener stands near each of three performers. Twist: the thought changes if two listeners stand there together.
works.exercise_zh: 用蓝牙信标或打印标记加手机网页，让听众站在三位表演者附近时分别播放不同的录音“心声”；变体：两位听众同时站在一起时，心声会改变。

works.title: Unwanted Waters
works.description: A dancer's live motion capture drives an avatar inside a WebXR scene that online audiences join from browsers or headsets, watching the performance unfold in a shared virtual space.
works.description_zh: 舞者的实时动作捕捉驱动 WebXR 场景中的化身，线上观众通过浏览器或头显进入同一个虚拟空间观看演出。
works.idea_en: A live dancer performs inside a web page that anyone can walk into.
works.idea_zh: 真人舞者在一个人人都能走进去的网页里演出。
works.technique: A motion-capture suit streams skeleton data over the network to a WebXR scene (on the OnBoardXR platform) where it animates an avatar in real time.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉服把骨架数据通过网络传到 WebXR 场景（OnBoardXR 平台），实时驱动化身。
works.exercise_en: Stream MediaPipe pose data from one laptop over WebSocket to a three.js or A-Frame scene where it moves a simple avatar that classmates view on their phones. Twist: let viewers change the room's lighting to affect the mood of the dance.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebSocket 把一台电脑上的 MediaPipe 姿态数据传到 three.js 或 A-Frame 场景，驱动一个简单化身，同学用手机观看；变体：让观众改变房间灯光，影响舞蹈情绪。

works.title: DISCORDANCE
works.description: Dancers in London and New York, both in full motion capture, meet in the same virtual space, co-present with audience members in VR headsets and with spectators watching in a theatre.
works.description_zh: 伦敦和纽约的舞者都穿着全身动作捕捉服，在同一个虚拟空间相遇，与戴 VR 头显的观众同在，剧场里的观众也在观看。
works.idea_en: Two cities, one virtual stage, three kinds of audience.
works.idea_zh: 两座城市，一个虚拟舞台，三种观众。
works.technique: Motion-capture data from both cities is streamed into a shared real-time VR scene, which is also projected for the theatre audience.
works.technique_zh: 两地的动作捕捉数据实时传入共享的 VR 场景，同时投影给剧场观众。
works.exercise_en: Pair two groups in different rooms, each streaming pose data into one shared web scene, and choreograph a duet where avatars must 'touch' hands. Twist: add a one-second delay and make the delay part of the choreography.
works.exercise_zh: 让不同房间的两组人各自把姿态数据传入同一个网页场景，编一段两人化身必须“碰手”的双人舞；变体：加入一秒延迟，并把延迟编进舞蹈。

works.title: Social Distancing Shirt
works.description: A shirt with sensors on four sides detects when someone comes closer than two metres and plays a spoken warning, 'You are too close', until they step back.
works.description_zh: 一件四面装有传感器的衬衫，当有人靠近到两米以内时，它会播放语音警告“你太近了”，直到对方退开。
works.idea_en: Clothing that defends your personal space out loud.
works.idea_zh: 会大声捍卫你个人空间的衣服。
works.technique: Four ultrasonic distance sensors (front, back and sides) are read by a microcontroller that plays prerecorded tracks through two speakers when the 2 m threshold is crossed.
works.technique_zh: 微控制器读取前后左右四个超声波测距传感器，一旦越过两米阈值，就通过两个扬声器播放预录音频。
works.exercise_en: Tape an ultrasonic sensor and a buzzer to a jacket with an Arduino and set a personal-space radius that beeps faster as people approach. Twist: make it greet friends differently from strangers using a phone NFC tag.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Arduino 把超声波传感器和蜂鸣器固定在外套上，设定个人空间半径，人越近蜂鸣越快；变体：用手机 NFC 标签区分朋友和陌生人，给出不同的问候。

works.title: Stuck inside
works.description: A projection-mapped wall of paper pyramids shows day passing and shadows moving, until a tiny figure appears inside the pyramids, knocking and looking for a way out.
works.description_zh: 一面由纸金字塔组成的墙被投影映射，先是日光流转、阴影移动，接着一个小人出现在金字塔里，敲打着寻找出口。
works.idea_en: Make a flat wall of folded paper feel like it has an inside.
works.idea_zh: 让一面折纸墙看起来像有“里面”。
works.technique: Generative animation is mapped onto each face of the folded paper pyramids (likely with ofxPiMapper on a Raspberry Pi), with fake light and shadow reinforcing the depth illusion.
works.technique_zh: 生成式动画被映射到纸金字塔的每个面上（可能使用树莓派上的 ofxPiMapper），假光影强化了纵深错觉。
works.exercise_en: Fold six paper pyramids, stick them on a board and projection-map a moving light source across their faces with MadMapper or a free mapper. Twist: add a character that seems trapped behind one face.
works.exercise_zh: 折六个纸金字塔贴在板上，用 MadMapper 或免费映射软件在各个面上投出移动的光源；变体：加入一个仿佛被困在某个面后面的角色。

works.title: AVATAR
works.description: A solo performance on online self-display: the performer copies, mirrors and merges with projected webcam videos and internet footage of people documenting themselves, inspired by the mantra 'I post therefore I am'.
works.description_zh: 一场关于网络自我展示的独舞：表演者模仿、镜像并融入投影出来的摄像头视频和网上自拍记录，灵感来自“我发帖，故我在”。
works.idea_en: Perform the body as an internet profile picture come to life.
works.idea_zh: 把身体演成一张活过来的网络头像。
works.technique: Live and prerecorded webcam imagery is processed in Quartz Composer and projected on and around the performer, so live body and screen body overlap.
works.technique_zh: 现场与预录的摄像头影像经 Quartz Composer 处理后投射在表演者身上和周围，让真实身体与屏幕身体重叠。
works.exercise_en: Record ten seconds of a classmate's webcam selfie, project it at life size and have them perform a live duet with their own recording. Twist: slowly shift the projection off their body so the two selves drift apart.
works.exercise_zh: 录下同学十秒钟的摄像头自拍，按真人大小投影，让他和自己的录像跳一段双人舞；变体：慢慢把投影移出他的身体，让两个“自己”逐渐分离。

works.title: HYPER_
works.description: The performer's body shifts between 2D and 3D in front of a large immersive screen: with UV light and 3D glasses for the audience, her figure seems to dissolve into projected colour and step out of it again.
works.description_zh: 在巨大的沉浸式屏幕前，表演者的身体在二维与三维之间切换：借助紫外光和观众佩戴的 3D 眼镜，她的身形仿佛溶进投影的色彩，又从中走出来。
works.idea_en: Make a live body and a stereoscopic image trade places.
works.idea_zh: 让真人身体和立体影像互换位置。
works.technique: Stereoscopic video programmed in Isadora is projected behind and onto the performer while UV light isolates parts of her costume, so live and projected bodies merge in depth.
works.technique_zh: 用 Isadora 编排的立体影像投射在表演者身后和身上，同时紫外光只照亮服装的局部，让真实与投影的身体在纵深上融为一体。
works.exercise_en: Make red-cyan anaglyph video of a moving hand, project it on a white wall, and have a performer in white gloves align their hands with it while the audience wears paper 3D glasses. Twist: switch off the room light so only the gloves remain.
works.exercise_zh: 拍一段红蓝立体的手部动作视频投到白墙上，让戴白手套的表演者把手与影像对齐，观众戴纸质 3D 眼镜观看；变体：关掉室内灯，只剩手套可见。

works.title: CPA [Consistent Partial Attention]
works.description: Three performers sight-read a choreographic score made of found internet videos of people dancing at home, playing on laptops, monitors, a projector and heads-up displays they wear, so the audience watches attention itself being split.
works.description_zh: 三位表演者现场“视奏”一份由网上居家跳舞视频拼成的编舞乐谱，乐谱播放在笔记本、显示器、投影和他们佩戴的抬头显示器上，观众看到的是被分散的注意力本身。
works.idea_en: A dance score delivered through screens, including one in front of the dancer's eye.
works.idea_zh: 通过屏幕传达的舞谱，其中一块就挂在舞者眼前。
works.technique: A digital video collage is distributed to multiple displays, including head-mounted displays, and the dancers follow it live without full rehearsal of the material.
works.technique_zh: 数字视频拼贴被分发到多块屏幕，包括头戴显示器，舞者在没有完整排练的情况下实时跟随。
works.exercise_en: Put a short dance video on a phone in a cardboard headset and have a classmate copy it live while the class watches both. Twist: play two different videos to two eyes or two phones at once.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段短舞蹈视频放进纸板头显里的手机，让同学一边看一边实时模仿，全班同时观看两者；变体：同时给两只眼睛或两部手机播放不同视频。

works.title: MÆ – Motion Aftereffect
works.description: A solo performance about how XR changes the body: guided by internet monologues about VR gameplay, out-of-body experiences and avatar customisation, the performer moves between her body, a motion-captured avatar and a projected VR scene.
works.description_zh: 一场关于 XR 如何改变身体的独舞：伴随网上关于 VR 游戏、灵魂出窍和化身定制的独白，表演者在自己的身体、动作捕捉化身和投影的 VR 场景之间穿梭。
works.idea_en: Stage the gap between the body in the headset and the body in the room.
works.idea_zh: 把头显里的身体和房间里的身体之间的落差搬上舞台。
works.technique: The artist built a VR scene and motion-capture avatar that are projected live while she performs, combining ready-made 3D models with found audio monologues.
works.technique_zh: 艺术家自建 VR 场景和动作捕捉化身，演出时实时投影，并结合现成 3D 模型与网上找到的独白音频。
works.exercise_en: Have one student wear a phone VR headset in a simple WebXR scene while its view is cast to a projector, and a second student narrates what the first 'sees'. Twist: the narrator lies about the scene.
works.exercise_zh: 让一名学生戴手机 VR 头显进入简单的 WebXR 场景，画面投屏到投影仪，另一名学生讲述前者“看到”的东西；变体：讲述者故意说谎。

works.title: Field of View
works.description: A webcam feed of the moving artist freezes frame after frame on top of itself, so every gesture leaves a painted trail across the image, recalling old Windows screen-drag glitches.
works.description_zh: 艺术家运动时的摄像头画面一帧帧叠印冻结，每个手势都在画面上留下绘画般的轨迹，令人想起旧版 Windows 窗口拖影的故障。
works.idea_en: Your movement paints itself as a glitch trail.
works.idea_zh: 你的动作把自己画成一串故障轨迹。
works.technique: In Unity the webcam texture is not cleared between frames, so new frames print on top of old ones and create persistent trails of movement.
works.technique_zh: 在 Unity 里不清除帧之间的摄像头纹理，新帧叠加在旧帧上，形成持久的运动轨迹。
works.exercise_en: In p5.js draw the webcam image without clearing the background, masked by a person-segmentation model, to create live body trails. Twist: reset the canvas whenever the performer claps.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 中绘制摄像头画面但不清背景，并用人物分割模型做遮罩，生成实时身体轨迹；变体：表演者拍手时清空画布。

works.title: Inner Room (dance)
works.description: A ritual-like immersive dance where real-time motion capture of the performer transports the audience into a projected digital realm that shifts between friction and calm with her movement.
works.description_zh: 一场仪式般的沉浸式舞蹈：表演者的实时动作捕捉把观众带入投影的数字空间，空间随她的动作在摩擦与平静之间变化。
works.idea_en: The dancer's body becomes the weather of the room.
works.idea_zh: 舞者的身体成为整个房间的天气。
works.technique: Motion-capture data from the dancer drives real-time generative visuals (likely in TouchDesigner or Unreal) projected around the audience.
works.technique_zh: 舞者的动作捕捉数据驱动实时生成的影像（可能用 TouchDesigner 或 Unreal），投影在观众四周。
works.exercise_en: Map a performer's average speed from a webcam pose model to the colour and turbulence of a full-wall projected particle field. Twist: let an audience member's movement add counter-turbulence.
works.exercise_zh: 把摄像头姿态模型算出的表演者平均速度，映射到整面墙投影粒子场的颜色和湍流；变体：让一位观众的动作加入反向湍流。

works.title: Me See I
works.description: A dancer guides the audience through a landscape of memory and the subconscious, while his live brain activity is visualised and animates the digital environment around him.
works.description_zh: 舞者带领观众穿过记忆与潜意识交织的景观，同时他的实时脑活动被可视化，驱动周围的数字环境。
works.idea_en: Let the performer's brain, not only his body, move the stage.
works.idea_zh: 让表演者的大脑，而不只是身体，推动舞台。
works.technique: A wearable neuroimaging headset (likely EEG or fNIRS) streams brain signals that are mapped to parameters of projected generative visuals.
works.technique_zh: 可穿戴的脑成像头戴设备（可能是 EEG 或 fNIRS）传出脑信号，映射到投影生成影像的参数上。
works.exercise_en: Use a consumer EEG band (or a heart-rate sensor as a stand-in) to change the density of a projected forest while a performer alternates between calm and active tasks. Twist: hide the signal from the performer and let the audience guess what drives it.
works.exercise_zh: 用消费级脑电头带（或用心率传感器代替）改变投影森林的密度，让表演者在平静和活跃任务之间切换；变体：不让表演者看到信号，让观众猜是什么在驱动画面。

works.title: Inner Room (installation)
works.description: An immersive installation where the visitor's hand shapes both sound and space: moving it through the virtual room changes sound effects, textures and the architecture of the scene.
works.description_zh: 一件沉浸式装置：观众的手同时塑造声音和空间，在虚拟房间中移动手，就会改变音效、质感和场景结构。
works.idea_en: Your hand sculpts a room and its sound at the same time.
works.idea_zh: 你的手同时雕塑一个房间和它的声音。
works.technique: Hand tracking (likely Leap Motion) maps position and gesture to parameters of a real-time 3D scene and its audio.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪（可能是 Leap Motion）把手的位置和手势映射到实时 3D 场景及其音频参数。
works.exercise_en: In a web page, use MediaPipe Hands so the distance between thumb and index finger scales a 3D room and pitches a drone. Twist: open palm freezes the room in place.
works.exercise_zh: 在网页里用 MediaPipe Hands，让拇指与食指的距离缩放一个 3D 房间并改变持续音音高；变体：张开手掌时房间定格。

works.title: Luminoscope
works.description: A sculpture made from an old umbrella and cardboard boxes becomes a glowing object when projection-mapped visuals are wrapped around it and changed by the visitor's hand gestures in the air.
works.description_zh: 一件用旧雨伞和纸箱做成的雕塑，被投影映射包裹后变成发光的物体，观众在空中的手势会改变影像。
works.idea_en: Found junk plus projection plus a hand sensor becomes a responsive sculpture.
works.idea_zh: 废旧物加投影再加手势传感器，就成了会回应人的雕塑。
works.technique: Visuals made in Modul8 are mapped onto the sculpture with MadMapper, and a Leap Motion (via Geco MIDI) turns hand gestures into MIDI controls.
works.technique_zh: 在 Modul8 中制作影像，用 MadMapper 映射到雕塑上，Leap Motion 通过 Geco MIDI 把手势转成 MIDI 控制。
works.exercise_en: Projection-map a cardboard box sculpture and use a webcam hand tracker to change colours as visitors wave over it. Twist: each face of the box responds to a different hand.
works.exercise_zh: 给纸箱雕塑做投影映射，用摄像头手部追踪让观众挥手时改变颜色；变体：箱子的每个面只回应不同的手。

works.title: CHOREO
works.description: A dancer's recorded movements become a game: participants press keys to rearrange and trigger fragments of the performance, turning spectators into co-choreographers.
works.description_zh: 舞者录下的动作变成一个游戏：参与者按键重新排列、触发演出片段，观众变成共同编舞者。
works.idea_en: Play a recorded dancer like a video game character.
works.idea_zh: 像玩游戏角色一样“玩”一位录下来的舞者。
works.technique: Clips of a dancer are cut into short phrases in Isadora, and each key press switches or layers phrases on a projected display.
works.technique_zh: 在 Isadora 中把舞者片段剪成短句，每次按键会在投影画面上切换或叠加片段。
works.exercise_en: Film a classmate doing eight short moves, map them to keyboard keys in a web page and let others compose a dance by typing. Twist: the typed word decides the sequence.
works.exercise_zh: 拍同学做八个短动作，在网页中映射到键盘按键，让其他人用打字编舞；变体：打出的单词决定动作顺序。

works.title: Mudança de Dança
works.description: A dance piece made for the pixel media facade of the FIESP building on São Paulo's Paulista Avenue, where a dancer's abstracted body moves across an entire skyscraper at FILE LED SHOW 2017.
works.description_zh: 为圣保罗保利斯塔大道 FIESP 大楼像素媒体立面创作的舞蹈作品：在 FILE LED SHOW 2017 上，舞者被抽象化的身体在整座摩天大楼上移动。
works.idea_en: Scale a dancer up to the size of a building.
works.idea_zh: 把舞者放大到一整栋楼那么大。
works.technique: Dance footage choreographed by Kai-Wen Yang was processed into a low-resolution, high-contrast animation suited to the facade's coarse LED grid.
works.technique_zh: Kai-Wen Yang 编舞的影像被处理成低分辨率、高对比的动画，适配立面粗糙的 LED 网格。
works.exercise_en: Downsample a dance clip to a 20×30 pixel grid and play it on a wall of paper windows lit from behind, or on a building photo in AR. Twist: let the dancer only move in the lit windows.
works.exercise_zh: 把舞蹈片段降采样到 20×30 像素网格，在背光纸窗墙上播放，或在 AR 中贴到楼房照片上；变体：让舞者只在亮着的窗户里移动。

works.title: do.we.touch
works.description: Created at the Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab, this contact-improvisation duet explores consent and intimacy: performers wear pulse sensors whose heartbeats trigger stage light and projection while depth-camera tracking follows their closeness.
works.description_zh: 诞生于 A+E Lab 的 Choreographic Coding Lab：这段接触即兴双人舞探讨同意与亲密，表演者佩戴脉搏传感器，心跳触发舞台灯光和投影，深度摄像头追踪两人的距离。
works.idea_en: Let heartbeats light up the space between two people who are negotiating touch.
works.idea_zh: 让心跳照亮两个正在协商触碰的人之间的空间。
works.technique: Arduino pulse sensors and Orbbec Astra movement tracking feed Isadora, which drives DMX lighting and projection.
works.technique_zh: Arduino 脉搏传感器和 Orbbec Astra 动作追踪把数据送入 Isadora，驱动 DMX 灯光和投影。
works.exercise_en: Stream two phone-camera heart-rate readings (or clip-on sensors) to a projection that brightens as the pair's pulses converge. Twist: projection only appears when the partners are within arm's length.
works.exercise_zh: 把两部手机摄像头测到的心率（或夹式传感器）传到投影，两人心跳越接近画面越亮；变体：只有两人相距一臂之内时才出现投影。

works.title: Hypnagogia
works.description: An installation-performance about the state between waking and dreaming: the artist wears an EEG headband whose brainwaves play an orchestrated light sequence while she reads her recorded dreams aloud.
works.description_zh: 关于清醒与梦境之间状态的装置表演：艺术家戴着脑电头带，脑波驱动编排好的灯光序列，同时她朗读自己记录的梦。
works.idea_en: Show the conscious brain as light while the voice reveals the unconscious.
works.idea_zh: 用光呈现清醒的大脑，用声音揭示潜意识。
works.technique: A Muse EEG headband streams brainwave data to Processing, which drives lights through Arduino Firmata.
works.technique_zh: Muse 脑电头带把脑波数据传给 Processing，再通过 Arduino Firmata 控制灯光。
works.exercise_en: Use a breathing or heart-rate sensor to dim and brighten a string of LEDs while a performer reads a dream diary aloud. Twist: the lights react to the audience's collective noise instead.
works.exercise_zh: 用呼吸或心率传感器控制一串 LED 明暗，同时表演者朗读梦境日记；变体：改为让灯光回应观众集体的声音。

works.title: Illuminate
works.description: In an open space, a person's movement leaves glowing trails that appear in front of them in real time, as if the usually invisible wake of their motion were hanging in the air.
works.description_zh: 在开阔空间里，人的动作会在面前实时留下发光的轨迹，仿佛平常看不见的运动尾迹悬浮在空中。
works.idea_en: What would it be like if we could see our movement?
works.idea_zh: 如果我们能看见自己的动作，会是什么样？
works.technique: Camera-based body tracking feeds custom interactive visualization software that renders persistent motion trails onto a large projection or screen.
works.technique_zh: 基于摄像头的身体追踪把数据送入自研可视化软件，在大投影或屏幕上渲染持续的运动轨迹。
works.exercise_en: With MediaPipe Pose in the browser, draw fading ribbons from both wrists and project them life-size. Twist: each ribbon keeps the colour of the person who drew it so groups can 'sign' the space together.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器中用 MediaPipe Pose 从双手腕画出渐隐的彩带，并以真人大小投影；变体：每条彩带保留绘制者的颜色，让一群人一起在空间里“签名”。

works.title: Photorythms
