works.description: A computational portrait series and public installation: visitors sit in front of a camera and see their face detected and augmented live with rhythmic generative forms, making portraits more expressive than a photo.
works.description_zh: 一组计算式肖像和公共装置：观众坐在摄像头前，看到自己的脸被实时识别并叠加有节奏的生成图形，让肖像比照片更有表现力。
works.idea_en: Augment a portrait with rhythms that follow the face, not filters that hide it.
works.idea_zh: 用跟随面孔的节奏来增强肖像，而不是用滤镜遮住它。
works.technique: Face detection finds facial landmarks in a live camera image, and generative forms are drawn from those points in real time.
works.technique_zh: 人脸检测在实时画面中找到面部关键点，再以这些点为基础实时绘制生成图形。
works.exercise_en: Build a p5.js face-mesh sketch that draws concentric rhythmic lines from each eye and the mouth. Twist: the rhythm speeds up when the sitter smiles.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 的人脸网格做一个草图，从双眼和嘴部画出同心的节奏线条；变体：被拍者微笑时节奏加快。

works.title: Deep Dancing
works.description: A dancer's whole body becomes a musical instrument: in an immersive room, her tracked coordinates move and shape a spatial soundscape, so viewers can hear the quality of her movement as well as see it.
works.description_zh: 舞者整个身体变成乐器：在沉浸式空间里，她被追踪的坐标移动并塑造空间声景，观众不仅看见、也能听见她的动作质感。
works.idea_en: Hear how someone moves, not only see it.
works.idea_zh: 不只是看见，还能听见一个人怎样移动。
works.technique: Motion-capture data from a Motive system is sent to Max/MSP, where it drives spatial sound synthesis in the Immersive Arts Space at ZHdK.
works.technique_zh: Motive 动作捕捉系统的数据传入 Max/MSP，在苏黎世艺术大学的沉浸式艺术空间里驱动空间声音合成。
works.exercise_en: Map a performer's position from a webcam to left-right panning and hand height to pitch in a Web Audio page, played on four speakers around the room. Twist: sound only moves when the body moves smoothly.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Web Audio 网页中，把摄像头测到的表演者位置映射为左右声像、手的高度映射为音高，在房间四周四个扬声器播放；变体：只有身体流畅运动时声音才移动。

works.title: yaGrid
works.description: A dance meeting in a video-call grid, where human dancers share windows with Kinect-captured stick figures that act as neutral, non-human dance partners.
works.description_zh: 一场在视频会议网格里的舞蹈聚会，真人舞者与 Kinect 捕捉的火柴人共用窗口，火柴人成为中性的非人舞伴。
works.idea_en: Invite stick figures to your video call as dance partners.
works.idea_zh: 把火柴人请进视频会议当舞伴。
works.technique: Kinect skeleton data is rendered as minimal stick figures and composited into a Zoom-like grid alongside webcam feeds of human participants.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 骨架数据被渲染成极简火柴人，与真人的摄像头画面一起合成到类似 Zoom 的网格中。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe in the browser to turn each participant's webcam into a stick figure and show both views side by side in a shared grid. Twist: swap figures between windows so everyone dances with someone else's skeleton.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器中用 MediaPipe 把每个参与者的摄像头画面变成火柴人，并在共享网格里并排显示；变体：交换窗口中的火柴人，让每个人和别人的骨架跳舞。

works.title: The Placeholders
works.description: Three performers: one dances, one films, one extracts still frames from the live feed; each frame is projected immediately next to an image from a curated dataset, so the audience watches random meaning form and collapse.
works.description_zh: 三位表演者：一人跳舞，一人拍摄，一人从实时画面中逐张截取静帧；每张静帧立刻与策划数据集中的一张图并排投影，观众看着随机的意义生成又崩塌。
works.idea_en: Make a stage where a camera, a dataset and dancers invent meaning together live.
works.idea_zh: 让摄像头、数据集和舞者在台上一起即兴“发明”意义。
works.technique: A camera feed is sampled frame by frame on a laptop and paired with images from a curated dataset on a dual-image projection.
works.technique_zh: 笔记本逐帧采样摄像头画面，并与策划数据集中的图片配对，以双图形式投影。
works.exercise_en: Let one student film a dancer with a phone while another grabs a frame every ten seconds and projects it beside a random image from a class photo folder. Twist: the dancer must react to the pairing on screen.
works.exercise_zh: 让一名学生用手机拍舞者，另一名每十秒截一帧，并与班级相册中的随机图片并排投影；变体：舞者必须对屏幕上的组合作出反应。

works.title: Best Practices in Contemporary Dance
works.description: An ongoing improvised series with dancer Jorge Guevara: as he dances, Naoto live-codes glitch visuals in Hydra that sample and distort the webcam image of the dancer, and both react to each other.
works.description_zh: 与舞者 Jorge Guevara 长期进行的即兴系列：他跳舞时，Naoto 在 Hydra 中现场编程，采样并扭曲舞者的摄像头画面，两人互相回应。
works.idea_en: A dancer and a live coder improvise a duet through one webcam image.
works.idea_zh: 舞者和现场编程者通过同一个摄像头画面即兴合跳双人舞。
works.technique: Hydra, a browser-based video synth, takes the webcam as a source and chains feedback, displacement and colour functions typed live by the coder.
works.technique_zh: Hydra 是浏览器中的视频合成器，以摄像头为输入源，编程者现场输入反馈、位移和色彩函数链。
works.exercise_en: Open Hydra in a browser, use the webcam as source and take turns: one student dances for thirty seconds, the other changes one line of code. Twist: the dancer calls out words the coder must translate into effects.
works.exercise_zh: 在浏览器打开 Hydra，用摄像头作为源，两人轮流：一人跳舞三十秒，另一人改一行代码；变体：舞者喊出词语，编程者必须把它变成效果。

works.title: distanze
works.description: A musical instrument for two players: a camera tracks both bodies and the distances between their noses, hips and hands control a synthesiser, so empty space becomes an invisible interface for music.
works.description_zh: 一件两人演奏的乐器：摄像头追踪两人身体，他们的鼻子、臀部和手之间的距离控制合成器，空无一物的空间成了看不见的音乐界面。
works.idea_en: Play music with the space between two bodies.
works.idea_zh: 用两个身体之间的空间演奏音乐。
works.technique: A machine-learning pose model analyses the camera image, and distances between chosen body keypoints of the two players are mapped to synthesiser parameters.
works.technique_zh: 机器学习姿态模型分析摄像头画面，两位演奏者指定身体关键点之间的距离被映射为合成器参数。
works.exercise_en: With ml5.js pose detection, map the distance between two people's wrists to pitch and between their heads to volume. Twist: add a third person whose presence changes the scale.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ml5.js 姿态识别，把两人手腕之间的距离映射为音高、头部之间的距离映射为音量；变体：加入第三人，他的出现会改变音阶。

works.title: CON/TOUCH #2
works.description: Two people wear wireless sensors on their shoulders; touching and pressing each other's shoulders generates and modulates sound, making a musical instrument out of social touch.
works.description_zh: 两个人在肩上佩戴无线传感器；触碰和按压对方的肩膀就会产生并调制声音，把社交触碰变成乐器。
works.idea_en: An instrument that can only be played by touching another person.
works.idea_zh: 一件只能通过触碰另一个人来演奏的乐器。
works.technique: Wireless wearable sensors measure haptic gestures on the shoulders and send them to a software synthesiser that maps them to frequency and timbre.
works.technique_zh: 无线可穿戴传感器测量肩部的触碰手势，发送给软件合成器映射为频率和音色。
works.exercise_en: Sew conductive fabric pads onto two shoulder straps and connect them to a Makey Makey or micro:bit so touch triggers notes. Twist: sound only plays while both people are touching at once.
works.exercise_zh: 在两条肩带上缝导电布片，接到 Makey Makey 或 micro:bit，触碰即触发音符；变体：只有两人同时触碰时才发声。

works.title: Passaggi // Presenze
works.description: A site-specific installation made with Lily Hassioti: every time someone crosses a doorway the note of a synthesiser changes and their image is archived, while a camera maps where people stand so the crowd composes sound and visuals together.
works.description_zh: 与 Lily Hassioti 合作的特定场域装置：每当有人穿过门口，合成器的音符就会改变，其影像也被存档；摄像头同时标出人们站的位置，让人群一起创作声音和影像。
works.idea_en: Doorways and footsteps become the score of a room.
works.idea_zh: 门口和脚步成为一个房间的乐谱。
works.technique: Laser proximity sensors at the doors detect passages, and a machine-learning camera tracker maps visitor positions to sound parameters and projected visuals.
works.technique_zh: 门口的激光测距传感器检测通过，机器学习摄像头追踪把观众位置映射为声音参数和投影影像。
works.exercise_en: Put a phone camera over a classroom door and use a simple motion detector to change a chord every time someone walks through. Twist: record a snapshot of each passer and project the growing collage.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室门上方放一部手机摄像头，用简单的动作检测，每当有人走过就换一个和弦；变体：拍下每位通过者的快照，并投影不断增长的拼贴。

works.title: The Cost of Your Words
works.description: A public sculpture outside the Royal Society of Sculptors advertises itself through Google Ads and displays, on its LED surface, the live price that words cost to reach people online.
works.description_zh: 英国皇家雕塑家协会门外的一件公共雕塑，它自己在 Google Ads 上投放广告，并在 LED 表面显示词语在网上触达人所花费的实时价格。
works.idea_en: Show passers-by what their words are worth to an algorithm.
works.idea_zh: 让路人看到他们的词语对算法值多少钱。
works.technique: The sculpture's ad account data (keywords and cost per click) is fetched from Google Ads and shown on an integrated LED display.
works.technique_zh: 从 Google Ads 获取雕塑广告账户的数据（关键词和单次点击价格），显示在集成的 LED 屏上。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR label or a paper sign that shows the live search-trend score of a word written on a classroom object. Twist: let visitors pick the word and see its value change.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 标签或纸质标牌，显示贴在教室物品上的词语的实时搜索热度；变体：让观众自选词语，看它的“价值”变化。

works.title: The Keywords Karaoke
works.description: A karaoke machine plays songs whose lyrics and music are generated by AI from the search keywords of the local area, inviting visitors to sing the data of their neighbourhood.
works.description_zh: 一台卡拉 OK 机播放 AI 生成的歌曲，歌词和音乐来自当地的搜索关键词，邀请观众把自己街区的数据唱出来。
works.idea_en: Sing your neighbourhood's search history.
works.idea_zh: 唱出你所在街区的搜索记录。
works.technique: Geo-localised keyword data is fed to AI models that generate lyrics and music, played back with karaoke-style on-screen lyrics.
works.technique_zh: 带地理位置的关键词数据输入 AI 模型生成歌词和音乐，并以卡拉 OK 式的屏幕歌词播放。
works.exercise_en: Collect ten words students see on the walk to school, have a text model write a chorus and perform it karaoke-style in class. Twist: each street gets its own verse.
works.exercise_zh: 收集学生上学路上看到的十个词，用文本模型写一段副歌，在课堂上以卡拉 OK 方式演唱；变体：每条街道各有一段主歌。

works.title: The Measures Taken
works.description: Five dancers perform inside projected lines, particles and light planes that are generated from their own tracked movement in real time, so the set keeps redrawing itself around their bodies.
works.description_zh: 五位舞者在投影的线条、粒子和光面中起舞，这些影像由他们被追踪的动作实时生成，布景随身体不断重新绘制。
works.idea_en: A stage that is drawn by the way a machine 'sees' the dancers.
works.idea_zh: 舞台由机器“看见”舞者的方式绘制出来。
works.technique: Motion-tracking cameras (likely Kinect-style depth sensors) capture the dancers' positions and skeletons, and Marshmallow Laser Feast's real-time graphics project responsive visuals onto the stage and scrims.
works.technique_zh: 动作追踪摄像头（很可能是类似 Kinect 的深度传感器）捕捉舞者的位置和骨架，Marshmallow Laser Feast 的实时图形系统据此把响应式影像投到舞台和纱幕上。
works.exercise_en: Point a webcam and a projector at a wall, run a body-tracking sketch (MediaPipe or TouchDesigner) and draw lines that connect each student's joints to the nearest wall edge while they dance. Twist: make the lines lag by two seconds, so dancers duet with their own recent past.
works.exercise_zh: 把网络摄像头和投影仪对准一面墙，运行一个人体追踪程序（MediaPipe 或 TouchDesigner），在学生跳舞时画出连接各关节与墙边的线条；变体：让线条延迟两秒，舞者就能与刚才的自己共舞。

works.title: Pattern Recognition
works.description: Two dancers move beneath a rig of motorised lights that track them, follow them and gradually improvise their own responses, turning the lighting into a third performer.
works.description_zh: 两位舞者在一组电动灯具下起舞，灯光追踪、跟随他们，并逐渐即兴出自己的回应，成为舞台上的第三位表演者。
works.idea_en: The lighting rig watches, learns and becomes a dance partner.
works.idea_zh: 灯光装置会观察、会学习，变成舞伴。
works.technique: Memo Akten's system tracks the dancers from above and steers a grid of moving-head lights in real time, with behaviours that remember and vary earlier movement (likely custom openFrameworks software).
works.technique_zh: Memo Akten 的系统从上方追踪舞者，实时控制一组摇头灯，其行为会记住并变奏之前的动作（很可能是定制的 openFrameworks 软件）。
works.exercise_en: Mount a phone above a dark room and use it to track one person; drive a single desk lamp on a servo, or a projected spotlight, to follow them with a delay. Twist: let the light 'lose interest' and wander off when the dancer stays still too long.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机固定在黑暗房间上方追踪一个人，用舵机带动一盏台灯（或投影出的聚光圈）延迟跟随他；变体：当舞者静止太久时，让灯光“失去兴趣”自行游走。

works.title: Pattern Regression
works.description: An installation version of Pattern Recognition: a solo dancer is surrounded by a responsive system of moving lights that tracks and reacts to her in real time, and visitors watch the dialogue at close range.
works.description_zh: Pattern Recognition 的装置版本：一位独舞者被一组响应式摇头灯包围，灯光实时追踪并回应她，观众可以近距离观看这场对话。
works.idea_en: A human and a lighting machine hold a kinetic conversation in a gallery.
works.idea_zh: 人与灯光机器在展厅里进行一场动态对话。
works.technique: The dancer's position is tracked and mapped to pan, tilt and intensity of moving-head fixtures designed by Memo Akten, running as a performance installation rather than a stage show.
works.technique_zh: 系统追踪舞者位置，并映射到 Memo Akten 设计的摇头灯的水平、俯仰和亮度上，以表演装置而非剧场演出的形式呈现。
works.exercise_en: Build a 'light buddy' with three phone flashlights on stands controlled over OSC from a laptop that tracks a student with a webcam. Twist: give each light a different personality: shy, curious and copycat.
works.exercise_zh: 用三支架在支架上的手机闪光灯做一个“光伙伴”，由笔记本通过 OSC 控制，笔记本用摄像头追踪一名学生；变体：给每盏灯设定不同个性：害羞、好奇、模仿者。

works.title: Strange Stranger
works.description: Visitors walk through a grid of three-metre towers where light structures appear, transform and vanish; motion sensors record their activity so every visitor leaves traces that change the space for the next.
works.description_zh: 观众穿行于一片三米高的塔阵之中，光的结构在其间出现、变形、消失；动作传感器记录观众的活动，每个人留下的痕迹都会改变下一位观众看到的空间。
works.idea_en: Your 'data shadow' stays behind in the room after you leave.
works.idea_zh: 你离开后，你的“数据影子”仍留在房间里。
works.technique: Motion sensors capture visitor movement and feed a lighting system by Children of the Light and Luca Biada, which stores and replays these traces, seeded at the start by a recorded performance of four dancers.
works.technique_zh: 动作传感器采集观众的动作，输入由 Children of the Light 与 Luca Biada 打造的灯光系统，系统会储存并回放这些痕迹，起点是四位舞者预先录制的表演数据。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam over a corridor to log where people walk, then project a slowly fading heat map of those paths back onto the floor. Twist: project yesterday's paths in a different colour so today's visitors walk among strangers' traces.
works.exercise_zh: 在走廊上方架一个摄像头记录人们的行走路线，再把逐渐淡去的路线热力图投回地面；变体：用另一种颜色投出昨天的路线，让今天的人走在陌生人的痕迹之间。

works.title: Anti-Body
works.description: Three dancers, physically isolated but digitally connected, move between translucent screens while streams of motion-responsive code and particle imagery grow from their bodies, making them set, lighting and characters at once.
works.description_zh: 三位舞者在物理上彼此隔离、在数字上相互连接，他们穿梭于半透明幕之间，响应动作的代码流和粒子影像从身体里生长出来，使他们同时成为布景、灯光和角色。
works.idea_en: Live motion capture turns dancers into the light and scenery of the show.
works.idea_zh: 实时动作捕捉让舞者本身成为演出的灯光和布景。
works.technique: A live motion-capture system streams the performers' skeletons into real-time visuals by Uncharted Limbo Collective, which are projected onto layered translucent screens around them.
works.technique_zh: 实时动作捕捉系统把表演者的骨架数据传入 Uncharted Limbo Collective 制作的实时影像，再投到环绕他们的多层半透明幕上。
works.exercise_en: Hang two sheets of tulle one metre apart, project a particle system driven by a webcam skeleton onto both, and have a student dance between them. Twist: let the particles on the front sheet show where the dancer was one second ago.
works.exercise_zh: 挂两层相距一米的纱幕，把由摄像头骨架驱动的粒子系统投到两层纱上，让学生在中间起舞；变体：让前层纱上的粒子显示舞者一秒前的位置。

works.title: The Last Swan
works.description: An English National Ballet dancer performs Swan Lake inside a projection cube where watery haze and feathers ripple with her tracked movement; afterwards audience members step in and see their own presence reflected in the same environments.
works.description_zh: 英国国家芭蕾舞团的舞者在投影立方体中演绎天鹅湖，水雾和羽毛随她被追踪的动作泛起涟漪；演出结束后观众走进同一空间，看到自己的存在被映照在这些场景中。
works.idea_en: A classical ballet becomes a projection room the audience can enter and continue.
works.idea_zh: 古典芭蕾变成观众可以走进去、继续“跳下去”的投影空间。
works.technique: Motion capture on the dancer drives real-time visuals projected onto the walls of a cube, then an audience-facing tracking system switches the same generative scenes to respond to visitors.
works.technique_zh: 舞者身上的动作捕捉驱动实时影像并投到立方体的墙面，随后面向观众的追踪系统让同样的生成场景转而回应观众。
works.exercise_en: Turn a classroom corner into a two-wall projection 'lake' that ripples where a webcam sees people move. Twist: after one dancer's solo, replay her ripples at half opacity while the audience adds their own.
works.exercise_zh: 把教室一角变成两面墙的投影“湖面”，摄像头看到哪里有人移动，哪里就泛起涟漪；变体：一位舞者独舞后，以半透明方式重放她的涟漪，观众再在上面加入自己的。

works.title: Mirror
works.description: Two dancers are watched by an AI system that first mirrors their actions on screen and then distorts, intervenes in and reshapes how they appear to each other, in a duet between bodies and a machine gaze.
works.description_zh: 两位舞者被一个 AI 系统注视：它先在屏幕上镜像他们的动作，随后开始扭曲、介入并重塑他们在彼此眼中的样子，形成身体与机器凝视之间的双人舞。
works.idea_en: An AI mirror that starts faithful and slowly lies.
works.idea_zh: 一面起初忠实、后来慢慢说谎的 AI 镜子。
works.technique: Live motion capture and photogrammetry-based avatars feed a generative AI pipeline that renders an altered mirror image of the dancers in real time (details of the models are likely custom).
works.technique_zh: 实时动作捕捉和基于摄影测量的化身输入生成式 AI 流程，实时渲染出被改写的舞者镜像（所用模型细节很可能为定制）。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam 'mirror' that shows students their pose skeleton and slowly exaggerates one joint at a time. Twist: let a partner secretly choose which joint the mirror distorts, and see if the dancer notices.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面摄像头“镜子”，显示学生的姿态骨架，并逐个关节地慢慢夸大；变体：让搭档偷偷选择镜子扭曲哪个关节，看舞者能否察觉。

works.title: REfract
works.description: A dancer shares the stage with avatars in a projected digital desert full of floating letters; her motion-captured body drives the avatars, which gradually evolve and negotiate agency with her.
works.description_zh: 舞者与化身同台，身后是漂浮着字母的投影数字沙漠；她被动作捕捉的身体驱动这些化身，而化身逐渐演化，与她争夺主导权。
works.idea_en: A dancer and her avatars share one body and argue over who leads.
works.idea_zh: 舞者与她的化身共用一个身体，争论谁来领舞。
works.technique: Motion-capture data from the dancer is streamed into a game engine that renders the avatars and desert live on a large screen behind her (likely Unity or Unreal with an inertial or AI mocap system).
works.technique_zh: 舞者的动作捕捉数据实时传入游戏引擎，在她身后的大屏上即时渲染化身和沙漠（很可能是 Unity 或 Unreal 搭配惯性或 AI 动捕系统）。
works.exercise_en: Drive a free avatar in a browser with webcam pose tracking and project it behind a dancer. Twist: every 30 seconds give the avatar one movement the dancer must copy instead of the other way round.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头姿态追踪在浏览器里驱动一个免费化身，并投在舞者身后；变体：每 30 秒让化身做一个动作，改由舞者模仿化身。

works.title: Accelerating Dimension
works.description: Dancers act as game players who invite the audience into a multisensory adventure mixing live improvisation, motion capture, projections and AR, moving between physical and virtual dimensions.
works.description_zh: 舞者化身游戏玩家，邀请观众进入一场多感官冒险，把现场即兴、动作捕捉、投影和 AR 混在一起，在物理与虚拟维度之间穿梭。
works.idea_en: A dance show structured like a game that the audience co-plays.
works.idea_zh: 一场像游戏一样组织、由观众一起“玩”的舞蹈演出。
works.technique: Motion-capture suits drive projected avatars while AR views on audience devices add virtual layers to the room, with game-like choices shaping the sequence (details likely vary by version).
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉服驱动投影中的化身，观众设备上的 AR 画面为空间添加虚拟层，类似游戏的选择决定段落顺序（细节很可能因版本而异）。
works.exercise_en: Design a three-level 'dance game': each level is a movement task, and the audience votes with phones which projected world the dancers enter next. Twist: add one AR object that only phone viewers can see and the dancers must react to by listening to them.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个三关的“舞蹈游戏”：每关是一个动作任务，观众用手机投票决定舞者接下来进入哪个投影世界；变体：加入一个只有手机观众能看到的 AR 物体，舞者只能靠观众的提示作出反应。

works.title: Sensing Adjacency
works.description: An experimental piece where a dancer in a motion-capture suit performs next to her projected avatar, sensing how information is lost and distorted between her body and its digital double.
works.description_zh: 一部实验作品：身穿动作捕捉服的舞者在自己的投影化身旁起舞，感受信息在身体与数字分身之间如何丢失与变形。
works.idea_en: Choreograph the gap between a body and its imperfect digital double.
works.idea_zh: 为身体与它不完美的数字分身之间的缝隙编舞。
works.technique: An inertial (IMU) motion-capture suit streams rotations to a hub that animates an avatar in a virtual scene; the team tuned hip height and ground contact live and turned tracking errors into choreography.
works.technique_zh: 惯性（IMU）动作捕捉服把旋转数据传到中枢，驱动虚拟场景中的化身；团队现场调整胯部高度与地面接触，把追踪误差变成编舞素材。
works.exercise_en: Record a short phrase with phone pose tracking, play it back on an avatar and ask the dancer to learn the avatar's 'wrong' version. Twist: perform the original and the glitched version side by side.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机姿态追踪录一段短舞句，在化身上回放，再请舞者学会化身那个“错误”的版本；变体：把原版和出错版并排表演。

works.title: Leytonstone TrailblazARs
works.description: A walking AR app along Leytonstone High Road where phones reveal dance, music and stories about the street's history, all created by local schoolgirls with Pell Ensemble.
works.description_zh: 一款沿 Leytonstone 大街步行使用的 AR 应用：举起手机就能看到关于这条街历史的舞蹈、音乐和故事，全部由当地女校学生与 Pell Ensemble 共同创作。
works.idea_en: Young residents hide their own dances in the history of their street.
works.idea_zh: 年轻居民把自己的舞蹈藏进街道的历史里。
works.technique: Students filmed performances and built the trail in Blippar, which triggers video and audio overlays when phones recognise images or locations on the high street.
works.technique_zh: 学生拍摄表演并用 Blippar 搭建路线：当手机识别到大街上的图像或地点时，便叠加视频和音频。
works.exercise_en: Pick five spots around school, film a ten-second dance at each that tells one fact about the place, and attach them as AR markers with a WebAR tool. Twist: the dance at the last stop must quote a move from each earlier stop.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校周边选五个地点，在每处拍一段十秒舞蹈讲述一个关于此地的事实，再用 WebAR 工具把它们挂到 AR 标记上；变体：最后一站的舞蹈必须引用前面每一站的一个动作。

works.title: Upload/Unplug
works.description: A live gaming performance where the audience's choices on devices become data that is uploaded to shape David, a new human being, whose dance changes with what the room decides.
works.description_zh: 一场现场游戏式演出：观众在设备上作出的选择变成数据，被“上传”用于塑造一个名叫 David 的新人类，他的舞蹈随全场的决定而改变。
works.idea_en: Your data literally choreographs a person in front of you.
works.idea_zh: 你的数据真的在为你面前的人编舞。
works.technique: Audience members answer prompts on tablets or phones; the votes are aggregated live and trigger different choreographic sections and screen content (likely a custom web voting system).
works.technique_zh: 观众在平板或手机上回答提示，投票结果实时汇总，触发不同的编舞段落和屏幕内容（很可能是定制的网页投票系统）。
works.exercise_en: Build a quick web poll with three buttons and map each result to a projected instruction card for a dancer. Twist: reveal at the end what personal data each choice would have 'cost' the audience.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个带三个按钮的网页投票，把每个结果对应到投影出的舞者指令卡；变体：结尾揭示每个选择会让观众“付出”哪些个人数据。

works.title: Move: Build: Code
works.description: In a three-day summer workshop, 12–14-year-olds build and code a robot that responds to their own choreographed dance movements, ending in a performance with the robots.
works.description_zh: 在为期三天的夏季工作坊中，12 至 14 岁的学生制作并编程一个能响应自己编排舞蹈动作的机器人，最后与机器人同台演出。
works.idea_en: Kids learn to code by teaching a robot to answer their dance.
works.idea_zh: 孩子们通过教机器人回应自己的舞蹈来学习编程。
works.technique: Students wear or hold micro:bit-style sensor boards whose accelerometer readings are sent by radio to a small robot that reacts with movement and light (likely micro:bit).
works.technique_zh: 学生佩戴或手持类似 micro:bit 的传感器板，加速度数据通过无线电发给小机器人，机器人用动作和灯光作出反应（很可能使用 micro:bit）。
works.exercise_en: Tape a micro:bit to a wrist and send its tilt to a second micro:bit on a wheeled robot that drives when the dancer spins. Twist: make the robot copy the dance only after a four-count delay, like a canon.
works.exercise_zh: 把一块 micro:bit 贴在手腕上，把倾斜数据发给装在轮式机器人上的另一块 micro:bit，舞者旋转时机器人就移动；变体：让机器人延迟四拍再模仿，形成卡农。

works.title: Playscape: How to Build a Galaxy
works.description: A family show in which two dancers, Gabby and Ed, explore space while their motion-captured avatars build planets and stars on a large screen, inviting children to play along.
works.description_zh: 一部亲子演出：两位舞者 Gabby 和 Ed 探索太空，他们被动作捕捉的化身在大屏上建造行星与恒星，并邀请孩子们一起玩。
works.idea_en: Dancing bodies literally build a galaxy that children can watch grow.
works.idea_zh: 舞动的身体一点点搭建出一个星系，孩子们看着它长大。
works.technique: Dancers in motion-capture suits drive avatars and particle effects in a real-time engine that is projected behind them; it premiered in a mocap streaming residency (likely Rokoko suits with Unreal Engine).
works.technique_zh: 身穿动作捕捉服的舞者在实时引擎中驱动化身和粒子效果，并投影在身后；作品首演于一个动作捕捉直播驻留项目（很可能使用 Rokoko 动捕服和 Unreal Engine）。
works.exercise_en: Let children 'place' planets by freezing in a pose that a webcam detects; each pose spawns a different projected planet. Twist: planets only orbit while someone keeps dancing.
works.exercise_zh: 让孩子们摆出摄像头能识别的定格姿势来“放置”行星，每种姿势生成一个不同的投影行星；变体：只有有人一直跳舞，行星才会绕行。

works.title: Empa
works.description: A participatory installation where pairs swap live camera feeds through VR headsets, dancing and holding hands while each sees through the other's eyes, to test whether technology can create empathy.
works.description_zh: 一件参与式装置：两人一组，通过 VR 头显交换实时摄像画面，一边跳舞、牵手，一边透过对方的眼睛看世界，以此检验技术能否带来共情。
works.idea_en: See yourself through your partner's eyes while you move together.
works.idea_zh: 一起移动时，透过搭档的眼睛看见自己。
works.technique: Head-mounted cameras stream each participant's point of view to the other person's VR headset, creating a video see-through body swap (a setup similar to The Machine to Be Another).
works.technique_zh: 头戴摄像头把每位参与者的视角实时传到对方的 VR 头显，形成视频透视式的“身体交换”（类似 The Machine to Be Another 的装置）。
works.exercise_en: Pair students: one films at eye level with a phone while the other watches the live stream in a cardboard viewer, then they try to walk and mirror each other. Twist: swap roles mid-task without stopping.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组：一人用手机在眼睛高度拍摄，另一人用纸盒眼镜观看实时画面，然后尝试一起行走、互相镜像；变体：在任务中途不停下来直接交换角色。

works.title: 'Still Life' at the Penguin Café AR
works.description: A phone app places the animal dancers from the ballet 'Still Life' at the Penguin Café, such as the waiter penguin, into your room, where they dance on the floor next to you and can be photographed.
works.description_zh: 一款手机应用把芭蕾舞剧《Still Life at the Penguin Café》里的动物舞者（例如端盘子的企鹅侍者）放进你的房间，让它们在你身边的地板上起舞，还可以拍照。
works.idea_en: Take the ballet's animals out of the theatre and let them dance in your kitchen.
works.idea_zh: 把芭蕾舞剧里的动物带出剧院，让它们在你家厨房里跳舞。
works.technique: Animated 3D characters of the ballet's costumes are anchored on detected floor planes in a markerless phone AR app, with a camera button for sharing (likely ARCore/ARKit through a branded app).
works.technique_zh: 按舞剧服装制作的 3D 动画角色被锚定在手机无标记 AR 检测到的地面上，并提供拍照分享按钮（很可能通过品牌应用调用 ARCore/ARKit）。
works.exercise_en: Record one short dance with phone pose tracking, retarget it onto a free animal model and place it in AR on the classroom floor. Twist: make the animal only dance when two phones look at it at once.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机姿态追踪录下一小段舞蹈，重定向到一个免费的动物模型上，再用 AR 放到教室地板上；变体：只有两部手机同时看着它时，动物才会跳舞。

works.title: Virtual Stage x Holosphere
works.description: A BRB2 dancer performs in front of a 35-metre by 3-metre immersive backdrop, and his motion-captured body drives the real-time artwork around him as he dances.
works.description_zh: 一位 BRB2 舞者在 35 米长、3 米高的沉浸式背景前起舞，他被动作捕捉的身体在舞动中实时驱动周围的影像。
works.idea_en: A ballet dancer paints a 35-metre wall with his body in real time.
works.idea_zh: 芭蕾舞者用身体实时“绘制”一面 35 米长的墙。
works.technique: Low-latency VR-grade motion tracking feeds a distributed real-time rendering system of the kind used for virtual production, displayed across a giant LED or projection backdrop by Holosphere.
works.technique_zh: 低延迟、VR 级别的动作追踪数据输入一套虚拟制片常用的分布式实时渲染系统，由 Holosphere 显示在巨大的 LED 或投影背景上。
works.exercise_en: Split a long wall into three projector zones and let one dancer's tracked hands 'push' colour from one zone to the next. Twist: add a second dancer whose movement erases what the first one paints.
works.exercise_zh: 把一面长墙分成三个投影区，让一位舞者被追踪的双手把颜色从一个区“推”到下一个区；变体：加入第二位舞者，他的动作会擦掉第一位画出的内容。

works.title: The Multitude
works.description: A 20-minute playable story for two people who see projections of their own bodies and must use them to win over four elemental spirits of nature, some of whom are not impressed with humanity.
works.description_zh: 一个 20 分钟、供两人游玩的故事：玩家看到自己身体的投影，必须用身体去说服四位自然元素精灵，其中一些对人类的所作所为并不满意。
works.idea_en: Your projected body is the game controller in a quest to save nature.
works.idea_zh: 你被投影出的身体就是拯救自然之旅的游戏手柄。
works.technique: A depth or body-tracking camera turns the two players' silhouettes into projected characters that trigger story events when they reach, pose or cooperate (developed by Jamie Gledhill; likely Kinect with a game engine).
works.technique_zh: 深度或人体追踪摄像头把两位玩家的剪影变成投影角色，当他们伸手、摆姿势或协作时触发剧情（由 Jamie Gledhill 开发；很可能是 Kinect 加游戏引擎）。
works.exercise_en: Make a two-player shadow game: project each player's webcam silhouette in a different colour and ask them to overlap to 'unlock' a sound. Twist: one spirit only responds if the players move very slowly.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个双人影子游戏：把每位玩家的摄像头剪影用不同颜色投出来，要求两人的影子重叠才能“解锁”一个声音；变体：有一位精灵只在玩家动作非常缓慢时才回应。

works.title: The Intergalactic Hanseatic League
works.description: A month-long sci-fi time-travel adventure across King's Lynn town centre and online, with projected transmissions on historic buildings telling a climate story co-created with local children.
works.description_zh: 一场持续一个月、横跨金斯林市中心与线上的科幻时空旅行冒险，投影在历史建筑上的“星际来电”讲述一个与当地孩子共创的气候故事。
works.idea_en: Historic buildings receive messages from the future about the town's climate.
works.idea_zh: 历史建筑收到来自未来、关于这座小镇气候的讯息。
works.technique: Large-format projection mapping on town-centre facades plays episodic 'transmissions', linked to online content and school workshops in which children wrote the story.
works.technique_zh: 在市中心建筑立面上进行大幅投影映射，按集播放“星际来电”，并与线上内容和孩子们编写故事的学校工作坊相连。
works.exercise_en: Write a one-minute 'message from 2100' about your street and project it onto the school building after dark with a borrowed projector. Twist: the message must refer to a real detail of the wall it is projected on.
works.exercise_zh: 写一段关于你们街道的一分钟“来自 2100 年的讯息”，天黑后用借来的投影仪投到校舍上；变体：讯息必须提到被投墙面上的一个真实细节。

works.title: Sound Mirrors
works.description: A large sound sculpture and projection in King's Lynn that played back young people's reflections on their identity and their town, inviting passers-by to stop and listen.
works.description_zh: 金斯林的一件大型声音雕塑与投影作品，播放年轻人对自身身份和家乡的感想，邀请路人驻足聆听。
works.idea_en: A town listens to its young people through a giant ear and a projected image.
works.idea_zh: 一座小镇通过一只巨大的“耳朵”和投影，倾听它的年轻人。
works.technique: A physical sound-mirror structure focuses recorded voices toward listeners while projected visuals on nearby surfaces show the words and imagery made in workshops.
works.technique_zh: 实体的声音反射结构把录制的人声聚向听众，附近表面的投影则展示工作坊中创作的文字和图像。
works.exercise_en: Record classmates answering 'what does this place sound like?', then play the clips from a parabolic umbrella so only one person at a time can hear them. Twist: project the transcript only when someone is standing at the listening spot.
works.exercise_zh: 录下同学回答“这个地方听起来像什么？”，再用抛物面雨伞播放，让同一时间只有一个人能听到；变体：只有当有人站在聆听点时，才投影出文字稿。

works.title: Walking With Pride: The Colours of History
works.description: A town-wide augmented reality trail and exhibition in King's Lynn that reveals the town's LGBTQ+ histories at the places where they happened, co-created with local young creatives.
works.description_zh: 遍布金斯林全城的 AR 路线与展览，在事件发生的原址揭示这座小镇的 LGBTQ+ 历史，由当地年轻创作者共同完成。
works.idea_en: Hidden histories reappear exactly where they happened when you raise your phone.
works.idea_zh: 举起手机，被隐藏的历史就在它发生的地方重新出现。
works.technique: Location-anchored phone AR places illustrated figures and stories at sites around the town centre, supported by printed trail maps and a gallery exhibition (likely WebAR image or geo anchors).
works.technique_zh: 基于位置的手机 AR 在市中心各处放置插画人物和故事，配合印刷路线图和画廊展览（很可能使用 WebAR 图像或地理锚点）。
works.exercise_en: Research one forgotten story from your neighbourhood, draw its main character and anchor it with WebAR at the real location. Twist: the character must point toward the next stop of the trail.
works.exercise_zh: 调查你所在街区的一个被遗忘的故事，画出主角，用 WebAR 把它锚定在真实地点；变体：角色必须指向路线的下一站。

works.title: Las Awichas
works.description: Andean grandmothers' stories live inside AR robotic animals, from geckos to jaguars, that appear around the viewer and respond to hand movements and voice commands while they narrate.
works.description_zh: 安第斯祖母们的故事住在 AR 机器动物体内，从壁虎到美洲豹，它们出现在观众周围，一边讲述，一边回应观众的手势和语音指令。
works.idea_en: Grandmothers' wisdom is carried by AR animals that listen back.
works.idea_zh: 祖母的智慧由会“听你说话”的 AR 动物来传递。
works.technique: Phone or headset AR anchors animated robotic animals in the room, while hand tracking and speech recognition feed an AI dialogue layer that makes each animal reply (built with King's College London).
works.technique_zh: 手机或头显 AR 把动画机器动物锚定在房间里，手部追踪和语音识别输入 AI 对话层，让每只动物作出回答（与伦敦国王学院合作）。
works.exercise_en: Record an elder in your family telling a short story, then attach it to an AR animal that plays the next sentence each time you wave. Twist: the animal asks the viewer a question back at the end.
works.exercise_zh: 录下家中长辈讲的一个小故事，把它挂在一只 AR 动物上，每挥一次手就播放下一句；变体：结尾时让动物反问观众一个问题。

works.title: Huk, the Jaguaress
works.description: An interactive installation where Huk, a digital jaguar deity, watches visitors through a robotic camera, senses them and speaks back, generating short films in real time about the burning of the Amazon.
works.description_zh: 一件互动装置：数字美洲豹女神 Huk 通过机器人摄像头注视观众、感知他们并开口回应，实时生成关于亚马逊大火的短片。
works.idea_en: A film that looks at you, judges you and answers.
works.idea_zh: 一部会看着你、评判你并回答你的电影。
works.technique: Five AI systems are chained together: computer vision on a robotic camera, sensors and emotion analysis feed a language model and real-time voice and image generation that cut the film live.
works.technique_zh: 五个 AI 系统串联：机器人摄像头上的计算机视觉、传感器和情绪分析输入语言模型，再由实时语音与图像生成即时剪出影片。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam 'creature' that detects when a face appears and responds with one of five recorded lines based on how long the person stays. Twist: it forgets everyone after ten seconds, so returning visitors are greeted as strangers.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个摄像头“生物”：检测到人脸就根据对方停留的时长，从五句预录台词中选一句回应；变体：它十秒后就会忘记所有人，回来的观众会被当作陌生人。

works.title: Augmented Empathy
works.description: An exhibition at FACT Liverpool built around Instagram AR face filters and installations that let visitors wear speculative future bodies and try on the feelings of other species.
works.description_zh: 在 FACT 利物浦举办的展览，以 Instagram AR 人脸滤镜和装置为核心，让观众“穿上”推想中的未来身体，试着感受其他物种的情绪。
works.idea_en: A face filter as a way to rehearse empathy with other beings.
works.idea_zh: 把人脸滤镜当作练习与其他生命共情的方式。
works.technique: Face-tracked effects built in Spark AR are published as Instagram filters and paired with gallery installations, so the work continues on visitors' own phones.
works.technique_zh: 用 Spark AR 制作的人脸追踪特效发布为 Instagram 滤镜，并与展厅装置配套，作品由此延续到观众自己的手机上。
works.exercise_en: Design a face filter that shows how a non-human (a tree, a bat, a river) might 'feel' today, using Lens Studio or Effect House. Twist: the filter changes only when two faces are in frame together.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 设计一个人脸滤镜，表现一个非人类（一棵树、一只蝙蝠、一条河）今天的“心情”；变体：只有两张脸同时入镜时滤镜才会变化。

works.title: SHIRO
works.description: An audiovisual live show in which the two artists perform inside a structure of translucent screens while projected white lines and strobes pulse with the music, making the space seem to expand, collapse and flip.
works.description_zh: 一场视听现场演出：两位艺术家置身于半透明幕构成的结构中，投影的白色线条和频闪随音乐脉动，让空间看起来不断膨胀、坍缩、翻转。
works.idea_en: Performers disappear inside a room made only of projected light.
works.idea_zh: 表演者消失在一个只由投影光构成的房间里。
works.technique: Synchronised projectors map generative line patterns onto front and back layers of semi-transparent scrim around the performers, with visuals driven by the live sound (custom software).
works.technique_zh: 多台同步投影仪把生成式线条图案投到表演者前后两层半透明纱幕上，影像由现场声音驱动（定制软件）。
works.exercise_en: Hang a sheet of tulle in front of a wall, project the same moving line pattern on both with a slight offset, and let a student stand between them. Twist: tie the line speed to a microphone so claps make the space jump.
works.exercise_zh: 在墙前挂一层纱幕，把同一条运动的线条图案略微错位地同时投到纱幕和墙上，让学生站在两者之间；变体：把线条速度与麦克风绑定，拍手就能让空间跳动。

works.title: DAYDREAM
works.description: An installation where visitors stand inside a tunnel of two translucent screens on which projected lines move with sound, creating the illusion that the room is stretching, rotating or dissolving.
works.description_zh: 一件装置：观众站在由两层半透明幕构成的通道里，幕上投影的线条随声音移动，制造出房间被拉伸、旋转或溶解的错觉。
works.idea_en: Two layers of projected lines are enough to make a solid room feel liquid.
works.idea_zh: 两层投影线条就足以让坚实的房间变得像液体一样。
works.technique: Two projectors cover a front and a rear scrim; phase-shifted line animations on each layer create moiré and parallax depth cues that bend perceived space, synced to an original soundtrack.
works.technique_zh: 两台投影仪分别覆盖前后两层纱幕；两层上相位错开的线条动画产生莫尔纹和视差深度线索，扭曲人对空间的感知，并与原创音轨同步。
works.exercise_en: Project two slightly different stripe animations onto two layers of fabric and walk between them with the lights off. Twist: let a phone's gyroscope control the phase shift so one visitor 'tilts' the room for everyone.
works.exercise_zh: 关灯后，把两段略有差异的条纹动画投到两层布上，在它们之间行走；变体：让手机陀螺仪控制相位差，一位观众就能为所有人“倾斜”房间。

works.title: VERSUS
works.description: An immersive audiovisual piece made for the Satosphere, a 360-degree projection dome, where monochrome geometric light patterns sweep over and around the audience lying and standing below.
works.description_zh: 为 Satosphere（360 度投影穹顶）创作的沉浸式视听作品，黑白几何光纹在躺着或站着的观众头顶与四周扫过。
works.idea_en: A whole dome becomes one moving optical illusion.
works.idea_zh: 整座穹顶变成一个运动中的视错觉。
works.technique: Generative line and grid patterns are rendered in dome-master format and mapped across the dome's projectors, synchronised with spatial sound.
works.technique_zh: 生成式线条与网格图案以穹顶母版格式渲染，映射到穹顶的多台投影仪上，并与空间声音同步。
works.exercise_en: Build a mini dome with an umbrella lined with white paper and a phone projector, then design a pattern that makes viewers feel they are rising. Twist: the pattern must work only when viewed from lying on the floor.
works.exercise_zh: 用内衬白纸的雨伞和手机投影仪做一个迷你穹顶，设计一种让观众感觉自己在上升的图案；变体：图案只有躺在地上看才成立。

works.title: NARCISSE
works.description: A kinetic light installation where a ceiling of motorised light panels tilts and glows in sequence, and its movements are doubled in a reflective surface below, like a self-regarding light creature.
works.description_zh: 一件动态灯光装置：天花板上的电动灯板依次倾斜、发光，其动作被下方的反射面加倍映出，像一只凝视自己的光之生物。
works.idea_en: Light that watches its own reflection move.
works.idea_zh: 看着自己倒影移动的光。
works.technique: Arrays of servo-driven LED panels are choreographed from a timeline synced to sound, and a mirror-like floor surface reflects them to double the space (reflection setup likely varies per venue).
works.technique_zh: 由伺服电机驱动的 LED 灯板阵列按与声音同步的时间线编排运动，镜面般的地面把它们反射出来，使空间加倍（反射方式很可能因场地而异）。
works.exercise_en: Mount five phone screens on hinges showing white fields, animate their brightness to music and film their reflection in a tray of black water. Twist: film only the reflection and ask viewers which side is real.
works.exercise_zh: 把五块显示白色画面的手机屏装在铰链上，让亮度随音乐变化，并拍摄它们在一盘黑水中的倒影；变体：只拍倒影，让观众猜哪一边才是真的。

works.title: SÉANCE
works.description: Twenty people sit around a table in a shipping container dressed as a Victorian séance room; the lights go out and, through headphones, a medium and unseen presences seem to move around and touch the group.
works.description_zh: 二十名观众围坐在一个布置成维多利亚时代降神会房间的集装箱里；灯灭之后，耳机里的通灵者和看不见的“存在”仿佛在众人身边走动，甚至触碰他们。
works.idea_en: Total darkness plus binaural sound makes a group believe something has entered the room.
works.idea_zh: 完全黑暗加上双耳立体声，让一群人相信有东西进入了房间。
works.technique: Pre-recorded binaural audio (recorded with a dummy head at each seat position) is played in sync to every headset while small physical effects such as air, vibration and touch are triggered in the dark container.
works.technique_zh: 每个座位位置都用仿真人头录制双耳音频，演出时同步播放到每副耳机，同时在黑暗的集装箱里触发气流、震动、触碰等小型实体效果。
works.exercise_en: Record a 3-minute binaural 'ghost story' with a dummy head or in-ear binaural mics in your classroom, then play it to classmates blindfolded in the same seats. Twist: add one real physical cue (a draught, a tap on the table) timed to the audio.
works.exercise_zh: 用仿真人头或入耳式双耳麦克风在教室里录一段 3 分钟的双耳“鬼故事”，再让同学蒙眼坐在同样的位置收听；变体：加入一个与音频同步的真实物理提示（一阵风、桌面的一次敲击）。

works.title: FLIGHT
works.description: Audiences board a 40ft shipping container built as an exact Airbus economy cabin, buckle in and, in complete darkness, hear a flight that splits into two realities: in one the plane lands, in the other it does not.
works.description_zh: 观众登上一个按空客经济舱一比一复制的 40 英尺集装箱，系好安全带，在完全黑暗中聆听一段航程：航班分裂成两个现实，一个平安降落，另一个没有。
works.idea_en: A real seat and seatbelt plus binaural sound let two parallel worlds happen to your body.
works.idea_zh: 真实的座椅和安全带配合双耳声音，让两个平行世界发生在你的身体上。
works.technique: A physical replica cabin supplies touch and posture while binaural recordings, seat motion and lighting blackout supply the narrative, borrowing the many-worlds interpretation of quantum mechanics as the plot device.
works.technique_zh: 实体仿真机舱提供触感和坐姿，双耳录音、座椅动作与全黑环境负责叙事，并借用量子力学“多世界诠释”作为情节装置。
works.exercise_en: Choose a familiar seat (bus, dentist chair, cinema) and design a 2-minute audio piece that makes it feel like it is moving. Twist: branch the audio so that listeners in two halves of the room get different endings.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个熟悉的座位（公交座椅、牙医椅、影院座椅），设计一段 2 分钟的音频，让人感觉座位在移动；变体：让音频分叉，房间两侧的听众听到不同的结局。

works.title: DOUBLE (DARKFIELD RADIO)
works.description: Two people who live together sit at their own kitchen table facing each other, put on headphones and close their eyes; a phone app then plays a story about the Capgras delusion, the fear that a loved one has been replaced by an exact copy.
works.description_zh: 两位同住的人在自家厨房餐桌两侧相对而坐，戴上耳机、闭上眼睛；手机应用播放一个关于卡普格拉综合征的故事——害怕亲人被一模一样的替身取代。
works.idea_en: Your own kitchen and the person opposite you become the set of an audio play.
works.idea_zh: 你自家的厨房和对面的人，成了一出音频剧的布景。
works.technique: A phone app delivers a timed binaural recording scripted around a standard layout (two chairs, a table), so the sounds of footsteps and voices land convincingly in the listeners' own room.
works.technique_zh: 手机应用按时播放双耳录音，剧本围绕一种标准布局（两把椅子、一张桌子）编写，因此脚步声和人声能逼真地“落”在听众自己的房间里。
works.exercise_en: Script and record a 3-minute audio piece for two listeners at any table, including instructions such as 'reach out and touch the other person's hand'. Twist: give the two listeners slightly different tracks so they no longer trust each other.
works.exercise_zh: 为两位坐在任意桌边的听众编写并录制一段 3 分钟音频，其中包含“伸手碰一下对方的手”之类的指令；变体：给两人略有不同的音轨，让他们开始怀疑彼此。

works.title: EULOGY
works.description: In a dark container each audience member is guided through an imaginary labyrinthine hotel; they answer questions aloud and the story reacts to what they say.
works.description_zh: 在漆黑的集装箱里，每位观众被引导穿过一座想象中的迷宫般的酒店；他们需要开口回答问题，故事会根据他们说的话作出反应。
works.idea_en: A whole building exists only in sound, and your spoken answers choose which room you enter.
works.idea_zh: 一整栋建筑只存在于声音中，你说出的回答决定你走进哪个房间。
works.technique: Binaural 360-degree audio builds the virtual architecture while speech recognition on each seat branches the narrative according to the participant's replies.
works.technique_zh: 360 度双耳音频构建虚拟建筑，每个座位上的语音识别根据参与者的回答让叙事分支。
works.exercise_en: Build a voice-controlled audio walk of an imaginary building with a web speech API: at each 'door' the listener says left or right. Twist: let the narrator remember a word the listener said earlier and use it against them.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页语音识别 API 做一段声控的“虚构建筑”音频漫游：每到一扇“门”，听众说出左或右；变体：让旁白记住听众早先说过的一个词，并在之后反过来用它。

works.title: ARCADE
works.description: Players sit at retro arcade cabinets in a pitch-dark container and steer an avatar through a war-torn world; there is almost nothing to see, so the game plays out as 360-degree sound and physical effects around them.
works.description_zh: 玩家坐在漆黑集装箱里的复古街机前，操控一个化身穿越战火中的世界；几乎什么都看不见，游戏以环绕四周的 360 度声音和实体效果展开。
works.idea_en: A video game with the video removed: you become the avatar through sound.
works.idea_zh: 拿掉画面的电子游戏：你通过声音成为游戏里的角色。
works.technique: Branching choose-your-own-path audio is driven by arcade controls, with binaural sound and sensory effects replacing the screen.
works.technique_zh: 街机操纵杆驱动一条可自选路径的分支音频，双耳声音和感官效果取代了屏幕。
works.exercise_en: Make a 5-choice audio adventure controlled by a joystick or Makey Makey, played in a dark room with headphones. Twist: add one moment where the player must physically stand up or turn around to continue.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个用摇杆或 Makey Makey 控制、包含 5 个选择的音频冒险，在暗室里戴耳机游玩；变体：加入一个必须站起来或转身才能继续的时刻。

works.title: Bioluminescence
works.description: Glowing sea creatures drawn by workshop participants swim across the historic buildings of Chatham Dockyard at night as a large projected artwork for Electric Medway's Nocturnal festival event.
works.description_zh: 工作坊参与者画出的发光海洋生物，在夜晚游过查塔姆历史船坞的建筑外墙，成为 Electric Medway 夜间活动 Nocturnal 上的大型投影作品。
works.idea_en: Everyone's hand-drawn deep-sea creature ends up glowing on a heritage building.
works.idea_zh: 每个人手绘的深海生物，最终都在历史建筑上发光游动。
works.technique: Participants draw creatures in Procreate, which are animated and composited in TouchDesigner and Resolume and then projection-mapped onto the facades with Projection Mapper (formerly Dynamapper).
works.technique_zh: 参与者先在 Procreate 里画出生物，再用 TouchDesigner 和 Resolume 做动画与合成，最后用 Projection Mapper（原 Dynamapper）投影映射到建筑立面上。
works.exercise_en: Have each student draw a glowing sea creature on a tablet, animate it with a simple wiggle, and project the whole school of creatures onto a classroom wall or the outside of the building at dusk. Twist: add a webcam so the creatures scatter when someone walks past.
works.exercise_zh: 让每位学生在平板上画一只发光的海洋生物，给它加上简单的摆动动画，傍晚时把所有生物一起投到教室墙面或建筑外墙上；变体：加一个摄像头，有人走过时生物四散游开。

works.title: Gateway To Our Past
works.description: Code plaques on local walls invite passers-by to scan them with a phone and see artwork inspired by the history of that exact spot.
works.description_zh: 当地墙上的二维码标牌邀请路人用手机扫描，看到以该地点历史为灵感的艺术作品。
works.idea_en: Street walls become doorways to the history of the place you are standing in.
works.idea_zh: 街边的墙变成通往你脚下这片土地历史的入口。
works.technique: Likely QR codes linking to web-based animated artworks tied to each location, forming a walkable heritage trail.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是二维码链接到与各地点对应的网页动画作品，串成一条可步行的历史寻访路线。
works.exercise_en: Research three historic facts about places around your school, make a short animation for each, and put up QR posters at the exact spots. Twist: make the artwork only unlock when the phone's GPS is within 20 metres.
works.exercise_zh: 研究学校周边三个地点的历史，为每个地点做一段短动画，并把二维码海报贴在对应位置；变体：只有手机 GPS 距离该点 20 米以内时作品才会解锁。

works.title: A Vixen's Tale
works.description: Visitors walk through five wooden arches styled like a pop-up book and hold up a phone to follow an animated fox through gamified scenes from Janáček's opera The Cunning Little Vixen; a face filter lets them become the vixen.
works.description_zh: 观众穿过五座立体书风格的木拱门，举起手机追随一只动画狐狸，在游戏化的场景中了解雅纳切克的歌剧《狡猾的小狐狸》；脸部滤镜还能让他们变成狐狸。
works.idea_en: A physical pop-up-book set and AR together turn an opera into a walk-through game.
works.idea_zh: 实体立体书布景与 AR 结合，把一部歌剧变成可以走进去的游戏。
works.technique: Physical arches act as image targets and staging for phone AR vignettes that unlock chapters of the story with music from the opera, plus a face-tracking filter.
works.technique_zh: 实体拱门既是图像识别目标，也是舞台布景；手机 AR 小场景逐段解锁故事并播放歌剧音乐，另外还有人脸追踪滤镜。
works.exercise_en: Pick a song or story with five scenes, build five cardboard 'arches' with printed markers, and make one AR vignette per arch in Lens Studio or 8th Wall. Twist: the final arch only unlocks if the visitor has collected an item in each earlier scene.
works.exercise_zh: 选一首歌或一个有五个场景的故事，用纸板做五座贴有识别图的“拱门”，并用 Lens Studio 或 8th Wall 为每座拱门做一个 AR 小场景；变体：只有在前面每个场景都收集到物品，最后一座拱门才会解锁。

works.title: Madame Tussauds Fame Cam
works.description: At Madame Tussauds London, visitors point a phone at 25 celebrity wax figures and watch them come to life, react to the visitor's facial expressions or transform the scene around them.
works.description_zh: 在伦敦杜莎夫人蜡像馆，观众把手机对准 25 尊名人蜡像，就能看到蜡像“活过来”、对观众的面部表情作出反应，或让周围场景发生变化。
works.idea_en: A wax figure that moves only when you look at it through your phone.
works.idea_zh: 只有透过手机看时才会动起来的蜡像。
works.technique: Object tracking on each wax figure anchors animated overlays, while front-camera face tracking lets the visitor's expressions trigger the figure's reactions.
works.technique_zh: 对每尊蜡像做物体追踪来锚定动画叠加层，同时用前置摄像头的人脸追踪，让观众的表情触发蜡像的反应。
works.exercise_en: Choose a statue or poster on campus and make a phone AR effect that makes it blink or speak when viewers smile at it. Twist: the statue only reacts to the second person who looks at it.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选一座雕像或一张海报，做一个手机 AR 效果：观众对它微笑时，它会眨眼或开口说话；变体：雕像只对第二个看它的人作出反应。

works.title: Marvellous Missenden
works.description: A proof-of-concept AR trail through the village of Great Missenden that places Roald Dahl quotations over the buildings and landscape that inspired them.
works.description_zh: 一条穿过大米森登村的 AR 步道原型：把罗尔德·达尔的名句叠加在当年启发他的建筑和风景上。
works.idea_en: Show readers the exact spot that inspired a line of a story.
works.idea_zh: 让读者看到启发某句故事的真实地点。
works.technique: An iOS ARKit app with geolocated points of interest superimposes text and illustrations on the village scenery at each stop of the trail.
works.technique_zh: 一款 iOS ARKit 应用，在步道每一站按地理位置把文字和插画叠加到村庄景色上。
works.exercise_en: Pick a book set in your city, find three real places mentioned in it, and make a location-based AR trail that places the quote in the sky above each place. Twist: let visitors add their own sentence at each stop for the next reader.
works.exercise_zh: 选一本以你所在城市为背景的书，找出书中提到的三个真实地点，做一条基于位置的 AR 步道，把引文放在每个地点上方的天空中；变体：让访客在每一站留下一句话给下一位读者。

works.title: SEA LIFE AR Chatbot (Roxy)
works.description: Children at the SEA LIFE London Aquarium chat with Roxy, an AR character in a little craft, who guides them through challenges about the animals in the tanks until they become Junior Rangers.
works.description_zh: 伦敦 SEA LIFE 水族馆里，孩子们与乘着小飞行器的 AR 角色 Roxy 聊天，她带着孩子完成关于水箱里动物的挑战，最后让他们成为“少年巡护员”。
works.idea_en: An AR companion that talks with children about the real animals in front of them.
works.idea_zh: 一个 AR 伙伴，和孩子们聊眼前真实的动物。
works.technique: A mobile AR app combines a placed 3D character, a scripted chatbot dialogue and collectible cards triggered at each tank.
works.technique_zh: 手机 AR 应用把放置在空间中的 3D 角色、预设脚本的聊天对话和在各个水箱触发的收集卡片结合在一起。
works.exercise_en: Design an AR guide character for a museum room that asks visitors one question per object and rewards correct looks with a collectible. Twist: the guide only answers questions whispered to it.
works.exercise_zh: 为博物馆的一个展厅设计一个 AR 导览角色：每件展品提一个问题，观众看对了就获得收藏卡；变体：导览员只回答对它轻声说出的问题。

works.title: The Great Story of the Infinite Drawing
works.description: A monumental black-and-white fresco of Elly Oldman's endless drawing covers a wall and a floor puzzle; visitors point tablets at it and the characters of her ecological fable start moving.
works.description_zh: Elly Oldman 的“无尽之画”被做成铺满墙面的巨型黑白壁画和地面拼图；观众把平板对准画面，她那则生态寓言里的角色便动了起来。
works.idea_en: A giant hand-drawn wall where every corner hides an animated scene.
works.idea_zh: 一面巨大的手绘墙，每个角落都藏着一段动画。
works.technique: Sections of the printed drawing serve as image targets for a tablet AR app (AR by Artefacto) that overlays frame-by-frame animations by &Friends in the same line style.
works.technique_zh: 印刷画面的各个局部作为平板 AR 应用（由 Artefacto 开发）的识别图，叠加 &Friends 用相同线条风格制作的逐帧动画。
works.exercise_en: Draw one long collaborative black-and-white strip on paper, then pick five details and make each one move in AR with Artivive or Lens Studio image markers. Twist: hide one animation that only appears when two tablets look at it together.
works.exercise_zh: 在长卷纸上合作画一幅黑白长画，挑出五个细节，用 Artivive 或 Lens Studio 的图像识别让它们在 AR 中动起来；变体：藏一段只有两台平板同时对准才会出现的动画。

works.title: EVERY THING EVERY TIME
works.description: A mechanical split-flap display on a city street clatters through short, anonymous poems generated from live city data, such as traffic lights changing, car parks filling or trains arriving.
works.description_zh: 城市街头的机械翻牌显示屏哗啦作响，不断翻出由实时城市数据生成的匿名短诗——红绿灯变换、停车场满位、列车进站。
works.idea_en: Turn a city's live sensor data into poetry, shown on the street where it happens.
works.idea_zh: 把城市的实时传感器数据写成诗，就在事件发生的街头显示。
works.technique: Software pulls real-time open-data feeds from the city, strips identifying details and rewrites events as poetic lines, which are sent to a custom split-flap display (software by Paul Angus, development by Dan Hett).
works.technique_zh: 软件抓取城市的实时开放数据，去除可识别信息后把事件改写成诗句，再发送到定制的翻牌显示屏（翻牌软件由 Paul Angus 开发，程序开发 Dan Hett）。
works.exercise_en: Pick three live data feeds for your campus or city (weather, buses, Wi-Fi users), write rules that turn each change into a one-line poem, and show them on a phone WebAR sign at the spot. Twist: the poem may never mention a number.
works.exercise_zh: 为校园或城市挑三个实时数据源（天气、公交、Wi-Fi 在线人数），写规则把每次变化改写成一行诗，并在对应地点用手机 WebAR 标牌显示；变体：诗中不能出现任何数字。

works.title: Soul Paint
works.description: In VR you stand before a translucent body and paint where you feel emotions and sensations, with colours, textures and movement, then walk through a gallery of other people's painted bodies.
works.description_zh: 在 VR 中，你站在一个半透明的人体前，用颜色、质感和动态画出自己在身体哪里感受到情绪和感觉，然后走进一座展示他人“身体画”的画廊。
works.idea_en: Paint your feelings where they live in your body, then see everyone else's.
works.idea_zh: 把情绪画在它在身体里所在的位置，再看看别人的。
works.technique: Hand-tracked 3D painting tools in a headset let participants body-map sensations onto a shared avatar template; finished maps are saved and displayed as a collective archive.
works.technique_zh: 头显中的手部追踪 3D 绘画工具让参与者把感觉“绘制”到统一的人体模板上；完成的身体地图被保存下来，组成集体档案展示。
works.exercise_en: Print an outline of a body, let each student colour where they feel 'nervous' and 'calm', then place all outlines in a WebXR room as floating panels. Twist: let viewers walk into a body and hear the owner's one-word description.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一个人体轮廓，让每位学生涂出自己感到“紧张”和“平静”的部位，再把所有轮廓作为漂浮面板放进一个 WebXR 空间；变体：观众走进某个身体时，能听到主人用一个词描述那种感受。

works.title: Anatomy of Embodied Ecologies
works.description: A speculative real-time landscape of the Thames Estuary's intertidal mudflats, with microalgae and diatoms, reacts to the people moving in front of it, so bodies disturb and reshape the ecosystem on screen.
works.description_zh: 一个以泰晤士河口潮间带泥滩（含微藻和硅藻）为原型的思辨性实时景观，会对面前移动的人作出反应，人的身体扰动并重塑屏幕上的生态系统。
works.idea_en: Your movement becomes a force of nature inside a living digital mudflat.
works.idea_zh: 你的动作成为一片活的数字泥滩里的自然力量。
works.technique: Likely camera or motion-capture body tracking feeds positions into Unreal Engine, where particle and vegetation systems respond to presence and movement.
works.technique_zh: 很可能用摄像头或动作捕捉追踪人体，把位置传入 Unreal Engine，由粒子和植被系统对人的存在与动作作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Model a local habitat (pond, riverbank, lawn) as a particle system in TouchDesigner or p5.js, drive it with webcam body tracking, and project it at floor level. Twist: stillness should make the ecosystem recover, movement should damage it.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js 里把一个本地栖息地（池塘、河岸、草坪）做成粒子系统，用摄像头人体追踪驱动它，并投影到地面；变体：静止不动会让生态恢复，走动则会破坏它。

works.title: Around 7 Meters is more fun
works.description: A participant steers a joystick at one end of a 7-metre structure while the image they draw appears on a screen at the far end that only observers can see; the drawer must rely on the observers' shouts and gestures, and the result cannot be photographed.
works.description_zh: 参与者在 7 米长装置的一端操纵摇杆作画，画面却显示在另一端只有观察者看得到的屏幕上；作画者只能依靠观察者的喊话和手势，而且画面无法被拍照记录。
works.idea_en: Split drawing and seeing across 7 metres so two strangers have to talk to make one image.
works.idea_zh: 把“画”和“看”拆开在 7 米两端，逼两个陌生人必须交流才能完成一幅画。
works.technique: Custom software draws the joystick trajectory in real time, while a camera with machine learning detects phones pointed at the screen and blocks recording.
works.technique_zh: 定制软件实时绘制摇杆轨迹，同时摄像头结合机器学习识别对准屏幕的手机并阻止拍摄。
works.exercise_en: Pair students: one draws on a phone web canvas facing away from a projector, the other describes what appears on the wall 7 metres away. Twist: the describer may only use sounds, not words.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组：一人背对投影在手机网页画布上作画，另一人描述 7 米外墙上出现的画面；变体：描述者只能发出声音，不能说词语。

works.title: Hi-Tech Garden
works.description: In workshops at A+E Lab and Medway schools, children connect sensors to plants, read their biodata and turn it into sound and interactions, imagining a future garden where humans communicate with plants.
works.description_zh: 在 A+E Lab 和梅德韦各学校的工作坊里，孩子们给植物接上传感器，读取它们的生物数据并转化为声音和互动，想象一个人与植物能够交流的未来花园。
works.idea_en: Let children 'hear' a plant respond when they touch it.
works.idea_zh: 让孩子在触碰植物时“听见”它的回应。
works.technique: Likely capacitive or bio-electric sensors on leaves feed a microcontroller that maps changes in the plant's signal to sound and simple visuals.
works.technique_zh: 很可能在叶片上接电容或生物电传感器，由微控制器把植物信号的变化映射为声音和简单画面。
works.exercise_en: Wire a houseplant to a Makey Makey or capacitive-touch board so touching different leaves plays different notes, then compose a short 'plant duet'. Twist: map the plant's soil moisture to the tempo so a thirsty plant plays slower.
works.exercise_zh: 把一盆室内植物接到 Makey Makey 或电容触摸板上，触摸不同叶子弹出不同音符，再合作编一段简短的“植物二重奏”；变体：把土壤湿度映射为节奏，缺水的植物会越弹越慢。
